tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun rig gi cho ga gzhan phan rnam gnyis kyi gsal byed blo dman dga' ba skyed byed ces bya ba sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung rtsom 'phro can gyi kha bskang ba don gnyis lhun grub bzhugs// na mo gu ru ā nan+da puṇ+ya ya/ bla ma mchog dang rdo rje sems dpa' la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal bdag sogs sems can rnams/ /ngan song rgyun bcad rnam snang chen po yi/ /go 'phang thob phyir cho ga'i rim pa dag /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon po rje btsun mchog /kun mkhyen gnyis pa kun dga' bzang po yis/ /legs par bshad pa gzhan phan rnam gnyis kyis/ /cho ga'i zhabs 'degs legs bshad 'di bris so/ /de la 'dir ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba zhes pa'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing / dam tshig dang sdom pa dang / byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rjes su bzung zhing / gshin po'i don lho sgo'i cho ga rnams rim pa bzhin brjod na/ de la don gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po la gnas ji ltar 'os pa'i sar/ ras la sogs pa'i gzhi bzang po'i steng du me tog sil ma gtor la/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor ras bris rab gnas can shar du zhal phyogs par bkod/ de'i mthar g.yas bskor du mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga bshams/ 'byor na mchod pa'i bum pa brgya 'bru dang sman dang dri bzang la sogs pa chus bkang ba kha rgyan dang bcas pa phyogs mtshams brgyad du bzhag mchod bum ma 'byor na ting la sogs pas tshab byas/ 'bru sman dri bzang sogs kyi chus bkang ba phyogs mtshams rnams su bzhag pa ni ma chad pa gal che/ gzhan yang bla bre dang 'phan la sogs pa 'byor na dgram/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi mdun du stegs ji ltar rigs par/ rdo dril/ dbu rgyan dar dpyangs rtsa chings dang bcas/ 'thor nas snod 'bru gang ba/

maṇ+ḍal gos zung / bum gdan pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du rnam rgyal bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa mgul chings kha rgyan/ bum mtshan rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bris pa gdags/ nang bum rdzas thun mong ba nyer lnga dang / kha phye la sogs pa btab pa'i chus bum pa sum gnyis tsam bkang ba dang / dung chos rdo rje gzungs thag dang bcas pa gzhan yang slob ma la dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par bya ba'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ slob dpon gyi las dang / slob ma la bya ba gnyis kyi dang po slob dpon gyi bya ba la/ bdag bskyed/ bum bzlas/ mdun bskyed bsgrub pa/ bdag 'jug blang ba'o/ /dang po la sgrub pa po rnams stan la 'dug ste/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes dang / rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang du zhugs par bsam/ de nas mchod pa rnams oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ ces dang / rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgyas bgegs bsal/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgyas/ dz+wa la'i sngags kyis gzi brjid bskyed/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang / 'phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mis khyab pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ ces brjod cing so so'i sngags dang / phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ sna tshogs rol mo dang / dharmā ra ṇi sogs tshar gsum gyis byin dbab/ skyabs 'gro spyi dang mthun par ji ltar rigs par byas nas/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa'i gung mo gnyis brkyangs te rtse sbyar ba'i phyag rgya dang / ngag tu/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa yin pa la de ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das kun rig gi cho ga nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/

/zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba dharmāḥswa bha wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes chos bdag med par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las rang skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i lkog mar hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa lce'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa nyal thabs su gnas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hā/ lag pa gnyis kyi mthil du a a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ hūm̐ la rdo rje rtse lnga pa re re/ de zhu ba lag pa la thim pas lag pa gnyis rdo rje'i rang bzhin dang / sor mo rnams rdo rje rtse gcig par gyur/ hūm̐ las bdag nyid khro bo me ltar 'bar ba sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje gsor ba'i tshul dang / g.yon rdo rje khu tshur gyis dril bu snyems pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ cung zad khro ba/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa na badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ baṃ/ zhes ti rin+t+ra'i phyag rgyas nga rgyal bzung / phyag rgya de nyid/ spyi bo/ dpral ba/ rna ba g.yas pa/ ltag pa/ rna ba g.yon pa rnams su bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na larka hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ gyis gnas de lngar rdo rje rtse lnga pa re re bsam la dbang blangs/ oṃ ṭuṃ dang / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis mdud pa 'ching bzhin pa'i tshul du byas la/ snying kha mgrin pa ltag pa dang / /snying kha nu ma'i bar dang ni/ /snying kha mgrin pa rgyab dpral ba/ /zhes pa'i gnas rnams su reg la/ dar dkar po zheng du khru gang pa/ dkyus su khru nyi shu rtsa gcig pas gnas dgur mdud pa bya zhing / dpral bar thal mo rtse sprad nas gsham bsdams te/ oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya ho/ zhes rna ba gnyis kyi steng du dar dpyangs kyi 'gugs byung nas lhag ma lus dang mnyam par bsams te/ bdag nyid rigs kyi khro bor bskyed la bsrung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na larka hūm̐ gis bgegs la bsnun/

oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭ kyis bsregs/ oṃ badz+ra nai tri ban+dha sarba big nan gyis bgegs bcings te sngar yod kyi bgegs bsal/ de nas oṃ badz+ra ḍi ḍaḍho mā+e bha wa ban+dha rak+ṣa sarban swā hās 'og bcings/ oṃ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭ kyis steng bcings/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis slar yang 'og bcings/ oṃ druṃ badz+ra ban+dha ham̐ gis shar bcings/ oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra pa sha hriḥ zhes pas shar gyi nang bcings/ oṃ pa taṅki pa taṅki ni ra tras nub bcings/ oṃ hrī badz+ra ka li ru ṭa ma ṭas byang bcings/ oṃ badz+ra shi kha re ru ṭa ma ṭas lho bcings/ hūm̐ badz+ra karmās dkyil 'khor bcings/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi ra bar bsgom/ oṃ badz+ra ban+dha baṃ gyis thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsgom mo/ /sngags de rnams lan gsum gsum brjod cing / de dag gi phyag rgya rim pa bzhin brjod na/ khro bo ti ran+ta'i phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje bsdams pa las sor mo brgyad nang du bkug mthe bong gnyis gshibs te mdzub mo'i steng du bkab pa'o/ /bgegs la bsnun pa'i phyag rgya ni/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur snying kar bzhag g.yas kyis rdo rje gsor ba'i tshul du bya'o/ /rdo rje me'i phyag rgyas bgegs bsreg pa ni/ rdo rje bsdams pa las sor mo brgyad nang du bkug ste bsnol nas kha gyen du bstan/ mthe bong gnyis srin lag dang gung mo'i bar nas rtse sbyar te bsgrengs pa 'bar ba'i phyag rgya/ bgegs bcing ba'i phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong gnyis brkyangs te gshibs pa rdo rje can gyi phyag rgya'o/ /'og bcing ba'i phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i sor mo bcu bsnol nas brkyangs la kha sbub tu sa la bstan pa'o/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed can gyi phyag rgyas steng bcing ba ni/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo brkyangs nas mgal me'i 'khor lo bzhin bskor te mgo bo'i steng du mdzub mo gnyis se gol gtog pa'i tshul byas la mthar lcags kyu'i tshul du bzhag pa'o/

/rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgyas steng gi 'og bcing ba ni/ mthe chung gnyis rtse sprad de brkyangs mthe bong gnyis brkyangs pa gung mo'i steng du bzhag mdzub mo gnyis mche ba ltar so sor brkyang ba'o/ /rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgyas shar bcing ba ni/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mthe chung lcags sgrog ltar sbrel/ mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo sbyar te bzlogs nas spyi bor bzhag pa'o/ /rdo rje zhags pa'i phyag rgyas shar gyi nang bcings pa ni/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rgyab sbyar te zhags mi'i tshul du byas pa'o/ /rdo rje ba dan gyi phyag rgyas nub bcing ba ni/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong gnyis rtse sbyar te brkyangs/ mdzub mo gnyis gshibs te sbreng ba'i rtse cung zad phye la/ mthe chung gnyis rtse sbyar te brkyang ba'o/ /rdo rje dus kyi phyag rgyas byang bcing ba ni/ gong gi rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgyas khu tshur sbyar la/ mdun du lag gnyis brkyang ba dang / phyogs bcur bgegs rnams tshar bcad par bsam pa'o/ /rdo rje rtse mo'i phyag rgyas lho bcing ba ni/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis g.yas nas bskor te g.yon gyis dpung pa'i thad du kha gyen du bstan te ri bo 'degs pa'i tshul bya ba'o/ /rdo rje las kyi phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor bcing ba ni/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo dang gung mo gnyis gshibs te bsgreng ba'o/ /hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rgyab sbyar/ mthe'u chung gnyis lcags sgrog ltar sbrel/ mdzub mo gnyis bsgreng ba'o/ /de ltar byas pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi ra bas bskor bar bsam/ sngags dang bstun rdo rje bsdams pa lan gsum bya ba ni/ thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsgom pa ste srung ba'i 'khor lo'o/ /de nas ngag tu/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo me ltar 'bar ba la ye shes kyi khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ

rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad bsreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can/ /log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba/ /rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal/ /log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wa ra e h+ya hi sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ gyis gdan dbul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wīd+yaṃ/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ hūm̐ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing / /thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa/ /khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can/ /gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras/ /ma lus dbang du bsdud la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing / /sdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ /nyon mongs dug can rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa/ /sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /dpa' bo'i stangs stabs brkyangs bskums tshul du bzhugs/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis/ /bgegs dpung bsreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs/ /rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrog /khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrog cing / /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/

/ces pas bstod/ de nas g.yas khu tshur sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas rdo rje bzung / g.yon dril bu gsil zhing / dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ /lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /nga ni gnas 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po 'bri/ /khyed rnams 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis/ /gal te nga yi tshig las 'da' byed na/ /ye shes can gyi rdo rje 'bar ba yis/ /mgo bo tshal pa brgyar ni 'gas 'gyur zhing / /bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /zhes pas bgegs la bka' bsgo/ rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas snying kar reg cing / oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐/ dpral bar reg cing / gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐/ lkog mar reg cing gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐/ spyi bor reg cing / a na ya hoḥ bha ga wān bid+ya rā dza hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brjod la bdag bsrung / sngags dang phyag rgya de nyid kyis shar nas bzung phyogs bzhi dang / me nas bzung mtshams bzhir g.yas bskor du bstan pas gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrungs te bgegs med par byas/ rdo rje las kyi phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong dang mtheb chung mdzub mo gsum rtse sprad pa brkyangs te/ oṃ badz+ra karmā kaṃ rdo rje srung ba'i phyag rgya ni/ gong bzhin las mdzub mo gnyis brkyangs te rtse cung zad kha phye la/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya ni gong bzhin las/ mdzub mo gnyis mche ba ltar so sor brkyangs la/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong gnyis nang du bkug de'i rgyab nas mdzub mo gnyis kyis mnan la/ oṃ badz+ra san+dhi baṃ/ zhes sngags rnams lan gsum re brjod pa ni/ bdag brtan par bsrung ba'o/ /de nas rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu gsil la/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa mā ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra sa twa twai no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍi ḍaḍho me bha wa/ pu to ṣ+yo me bha wa/

a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me lha wa/ sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karmā su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shrī yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra ma me muñtsa/ badz+ri bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥzhes dang / rdo rje'i rtse dril bu la bskor zhing / badz+ra sa twa brjod/ yang rdo rje snying kar bzhag cing dril bu chig brdungs dang / badz+ra sa twa tshar gcig ste mdor na lan gsum brjod pa ste brtan par bya ba'o/ /de nas/ rang gi lag mthil gnyis su a a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de dag gi dbus su hūm̐ dang a/ thal mo gnyis la/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ am̐ a/ zhes tshar gnyis brjod do/ /rnams kyis gang ba las 'od 'phros/ g.yas g.yon gyi mthe bong la oṃ/ mdzub mo la hūm̐/ gung mo la tram̐/ srin lag la hri/ mthe'u chung la a/ g.yas kyi mthe bong la rnam par snang mdzad/ mdzub mo la mi bskyod pa/ gung mo la rin chen 'byung ldan/ srin lag la 'od dpag med/ mthe'u chung la don yod grub pa/ g.yon gyi mthe bong la rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ mdzub mo la rdo rje thugs ma/ gung mo la rdo rje dbang bskur ma/ srin lag la rdo rje mtshon cha ma/ mthe'u chung la rdo rje kun ma rnams pho mo'i khyad par ma gtogs zhal phyag rigs lnga dang 'dra bar gyur/ mnyam pa'i thal mo dang / oṃ a n+yo a nu ga ta/ sarba dharmāḥs lha dang lha mo rnams la reg rdo rje thal mo dang / s+pha ra s+pha ra a nu pra biṣ+ṭa/ sarba dharmā badz+ra añdza li yis rjes su zhugs/ rdo rje bsdams pa dang / ad+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭaḥ sarba dharmāḥ badz+ra ban+dhas gcig tu 'dres pas sems 'od gsal bar bsam/ rdo rje bsdams pa dkrol zhing se gol gtog la/ badz+ra ban+dha traṭa kyis sdig pa thams cad bral bar bsam/ yang rdo rje bsdams pa dang / badz+ra ban+dha phyag rgya dkrol zhing badz+ra ban+dha traṭa sogs lan gnyis te gsum byas la rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong gnyis nang du bkug ste/

oṃ badz+ra a be sha zhes lan gcig dang / āḥzhes pa bcu nas brgya'i bar bzlas pas rang gi snying khar dang po'i rdo rje char bzhin du dbab pa'i mos pa bya/ de nas/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ḍi ḍaḍho me bha wa/ sha shwa to me bha wa hri da yaṃ me/ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥ zhes gsum brjod pa'i mthar oṃ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi baṃ/ rdo rje bsdams pa dkrol/ se gol gdab/ yang phyag rgya de nyid bca' zhing / badz+ra muṣ+ṭi brjod/ yang oṃ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi baṃ/ phyag rgya dkrol zhing se gol gdab/ bsdams pa dkrol ba de bzhin lan gsum byas pas ye shes dbab pa brtan par bsam/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bha wa shud+dho3ham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rab tu dgyes pa'i spyan gdangs pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod de 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa dril bu dkur brten pa sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ thal mo dpral bar sbyar la/ oṃ bh+ri ta bh+ri ta sarba a wa ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭ/ thal mo snyim par sbyar ba mgrin par reg la/ oṃ traṭa traṭa sarba a wa ra ṇa ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis mthe bong mthe'u chung rnams brkyangs te sbyar ba snying khar bzhag la/ oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha sarba a wa ra ṇa ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ rnams kyis sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis brkyang ba phyag na rdo rje'i phyag rgya spyi bor bcings la/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣits+tsha hūm̐/ zhes dang / thal mo mnyam par sbyar ba las srin lag dang mdzub mo gnyis rtse cung zad bkug pa pad 'dab 'dra ba byas pa sbyong rgyal gyi phyag rgya dpral bar bzhag la/

oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ de nyid las srin lag dang mdzub mo'i tshigs bar pa bcag pa rin po che 'dra bar byas pa dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgya rna ba g.yas pa'i steng du bzhag la/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ mthe bong dang mthe'u chung so sor mnyam la/ lhag ma thams cad brkyang ba sdig pa bsreg pa'i phyag rgya ltag par bzhag la/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hriḥ/ de nyid g.yon du bsgyur ba las thams cad pa'i phyag rgya rna ltag g.yon du bzhag la/ oṃ karmā a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ gnas de rnams su/ mi bskyod pa/ rnam par snang mdzad/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa rnams kyis dbu brgyan/ zhes brjod cing gnas de dag tu bzhugs par bsam/ de nas rang rdo rje sems dpar gyur pa'i smin mtshams nas 'od dpag tu med pa spros pas spyir sems can thams cad dang / bye brag tu ngan song gsum khyad par du tshe 'das sogs dmigs yul gang yin pa la phog pas 'gro ba de dag gi sdig pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bsams la/ ngag tu/ tshangs pa chen po pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs te ngan song gi rgyud thams cad yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas ngan song gi rgyud thams cad las grol ba zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 'od zer 'phro ba dang / sdud pa mang po'i phreng ba nyid kyi dpral ba'i mdzod spu nas phyung nas des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag thams cad kun tu snang bar byas so/ /kun tu snang bar byas pas/ sems can thams cad kyi sems nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las grol te/ bde ba so sor thob nas dga' ba'i tshal thams cad kun tu snang bar byas te/ mchod pa'i sprin sna tshogs kyis mngon par mchod de/ lan brgya phrag stong du bskor ba byas nas mgo bos lan brgya stong phrag du mar phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar nor bu dri ma med pa'i steng du 'khod de 'di skad ces gsol to/

/e ma ho sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas/ /e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa lags/ /gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs/ /byang chub spyod pa nyid la bkod/ /ces ched du brjod nas sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i 'gro ba de rnams kyis bdag la mchod par bsams la/ sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa rnams/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+gham̐ pra tits+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes sogs kyi mchod yon dang / de bzhin du gong 'og 'dra ba las ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi gnas su puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ dī paṃ/ nai wī d+yaṃ/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje thal mo snying khar g.yas su bskor zhing / sangs rgyas kun pas sngar sangs rgyas/ /zhes sogs 'og bzhin brjod pas bstod par bsam mo/ /de nas snying khar zla ba'i steng du/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga te sogs tshar gcig brjod de/ de las 'od 'phros dmigs yul gyis gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dag pa dang / ngan song thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ slar 'dus snying kha'i chos kyi yi ge la thim zhes brjod cing bsams la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri shwa dha ni rā dza ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te samyaka sam bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ shwa dha ne shwa dha ne/ sarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha ne/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe sarba karma a wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha ne swāhā/ zhes ci nus pa bzlas la/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod pas sgom bzlas kyi byin rlabs brtan par bsam/ de nas mchod rdzas rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas/ thal mo sbyar la/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas 'gro ba'i don kun mdzod/

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+gham̐ pra tits+tsa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin tshigs bcad dang / sngags rnams go brjes la/ me tog dang / puṣ+pe/ bdug spos dang / dhu pe/ snang gsal dang / ā lo ke dri mchog dang / gan+dhe/ zhal zas dang / ne wīd+yam̐/ rol mo dang / shab+da rnams kyis mchod la/ rdo rje dril bu dkrol zhing / oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha ṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pradz+nyā pa ra mi ta nā da/ sam+bha we badz+ra satwa hrīḥd ya ni san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a kham̐ swāhā/ zhes sna tshogs rol mo dbul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ sangs rgyas kun pas sngar sangs rgyas/ /mi shes dri ma kun bcom pa/ /rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ /rdo rje rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje sku ste sku che ba/ /phyag na rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje yan lag rdo rje mchog /rdo rje 'bar ba cher 'bar ba/ /rdo rje shugs te shugs che ba/ /rdo rje mtshon cha rdo rje che/ /phyag na rdo rje phyag chen po/ /rdo rje mda' ste rab 'bigs pa/ /rdo rje rnon po rno ba che/ /chu bo chen po rgya mtsho che/ /rdo rje pad+ma byang chub che/ /byang chub sangs rgyas rang byung ba/ /rdo rje rgya chen rgya chen te/ /rdo rje sgyu ma rnam sbyong ba/ /rdo rje rgyu ste gnod sbyin che/ /rdo rje pad+mo rnam sbyong ba/ /rdo rje khro bo ma rungs che/ /rdo rje dgra sdang 'joms pa'i gtso/ /rdo rje 'jigs pa bsrung ba che/ /rdo rje lcags kyu don yod byed/ /rdo rje ro langs ro langs byed/ /rdo rje srin po za ba po/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin gnod sbyin che/ /rdo rje gdon te gdon gyi mchog /'jigs byed dgra byed drag po che/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed rngam byed pa/ /bsgrub dka'i sgrub pa legs pa ste/ /rdo rje legs pa dges mdzad pa/ /rdo rje dga' ba dga' ba che/

/dga' ba'i rdo rje dbang byed pa/ /'od sdug pas ni sdug pa che/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam pa po/ /re ba thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /rdo rje dbang bskur rin chen mchog /rdo rje rgyal mtshan yon tan mtsho/ /rdo rje ye shes ye shes che/ /rigs sngags bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /ha la ha la nag po che/ /dgra chen zhing ni 'joms pa can/ /rdo rje 'dod pa 'dod pa che/ /snyigs ma'i lus ngan rnam sbyong ba/ /skad cig g.yo ba'i the tshom gcod/ /glog bzhin zhal gyi ljags las 'phro/ /rdo rje me ste ma rungs 'dul/ /drag po rab snang snang mdzad pa/ /nyi ma stong gis gdungs pa'i zhal/ /spyan dmar 'jigs pa mdzad pa po/ /khro bo du ma'i 'od bzhin 'phro/ /phyag rnams du mar mtshon cha brgya/ /du ma'i zhal gyi sku yang stong / /'khyil zhing rgyan yang 'khyil ba ste/ /sems kyi chos pas sku mi mnga'/ /rnam par rtog pa ma lus 'dul/ /ma rig 'joms pa'i tshangs pa ste/ /'dod chags zhe sdang srid mthar byed/ /sgyu ma khyab 'jug rdo rje can/ /rtse gsum rtse gsum 'chang 'phrog pa/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che/ /srid dang srid min rnam sbyong ba/ /zhi zhing dul la dga' ba ste/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas rab rtogs pa/ /sangs rgyas bdag nyid sangs rgyas sku/ /rdo rje rab dges rdo rje sems/ /kun tu bzang po cher bzang po/ /mtshan rnams dam pas rnam brgyan pa/ /khams gsum bdag nyid khyab pa po/ /thams cad rdo rje'i bdag nyid gtsang / /zhes bdag nyid la bstod pa'o/ /gnyis pa bum bzlas ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng du/ dung chos dri bzang gi chus bkang ba/ rdo rje gzungs thag dang bcas pa bzhag la/ yak+ṣas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+rum̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/

lha'i gos kyis mgul ba bcing pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu'i dbus su seng ge'i khri/ shar du glang po che'i khri/ lhor rta'i khri/ nub tu rma bya'i khri/ byang du mkha' lding rnams kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri steng du/ 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi gnas su pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar ba/ zhal bzhi dkar ba/ rtsa zhal shar du gzigs pa/ phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ shar du sbyong ba'i rgyal po dkar la cung zad dmar ba/ zhes pa nas byang du rdo rje dril bu ljang khu dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi lha so bdun po'i zhal phyag rdzogs par skad cig gis bskyed pa'i tshig rnams mdun bskyed kyis bskyed/ sngags bzhag la gzhan ji lta ba bzhin brjod pa'o/ /'on kyang rdo rje sems dpa'i sogs bskyed pa'i skabs su/ de'i phyi rol gyi shar gyi pad 'dab bzhi la rim pa bzhin rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po sogs/ de bzhin du lho'i pad 'dab bzhi sogs rigs 'gre /sgo ma bzhi'i skabs su shar sgo sogs sgo'i ming gi 'jug pa shar du rdo rje lcags kyu dkar po sogs brjod pa ste skabs thob shes dgos so/ /de nas rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas kun rig rtsa ba'i lha sum cu rtsa bdun la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spos dang bcas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /nas/ yongs dag 'khor dang bcas rnams gshegs su gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi sh+lau ka gsum 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dang / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bha ga wan e h+ya hi ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dri sha ho sa ma ya satwam̐/

zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ pad+ma ka la ma ya satwam̐/ ar+gham̐/ pūṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥnas/ a be sha'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin brjod la/ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du bsres/ oṃ bh+ri ta bh+ri ta sogs sngags dang phyag rgyas gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ bud+dha a bh-i ṣiñtsa sogs dang phyag rgyas spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad/ dpral bar mi skyod pa nas/ don yod grub pa rnams kyis dbu brgyan ces pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin brjod la dbang bskur/ de nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+gham̐ pra tits+tsha pu dza ma ེgha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ nas shab+da'i bar dang / sna tshogs rol mo dharmā ra ṇi ta bcas pas mchod/ de nas dril bu gsil zhing / chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag ces sogs nas/ rgyud bzhin bdag gis bstod par bgyi'i bar dang / sgeg mo phreng ba de bzhin glu/ /gar ma mchod pa'i lha mo dang / /spos dang me tog mar me ma/ /dri yi lha mo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sgo bzhi'i dbus na legs bzhugs shing / /dad sogs ngo bo rnam dag pa/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril/ /sgo srung rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ de nas lag pa pad skor dang bcas rdo rje gzungs thag blangs nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la zhon nas song bas lha thams cad kyi rgyud bskul/ sku lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bab pas bum pa gang bar gyur par bsam la/ rtsa rig nyer gcig nas brgya'i bar ji ltar rigs pa dang / lha so so la oṃ sarba bid sarba a wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes pa gtso bo'i sngags dang / oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ oṃ sarba bid phaṭ/ oṃ sarba bid a/ oṃ sarba bid tra tha/ zhes pas rigs bzhi dang / oṃ bud+dha lo tsā ni hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra mā ma ki tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra paṇ+ḍa re de hi de hi sid+dha bo dhi lo ki ta ram̐ pa swāhā/

oṃ badz+ra ta re tud ta re tu re hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swa swa swa swāhā/ yum bzhi dang / oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ra dza dza/ oṃ badz+ra ra ga ho/ oṃ badz+ra sa dhu dhū/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra te dzar+ya/ oṃ badz+ra ke tu bhṛ/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa hā/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣa ṇa dhi/ oṃ badz+ra he tu krum̐/ oṃ badz+ra bha ṣa bha/ oṃ badz+ra karma kam̐ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra san+dhi bam̐/ zhes sems dpa' bcu drug dang / oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ma le tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra girti hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra nirti āḥ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra a lo ke hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥ lha mo brgyad dang / oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ṭa bam̐/ oṃ badz+ra a be sha āḥ zhes sgo ba bzhi ste lha so so'i sngags lan gsum re dang / khrus kyi don du oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ de nas gong bzhin mchod bstod byas la gzungs thag bsdus/ dung chos kyi chu bum nang du blug oṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis/ bum nang gi ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces brjod cing / yi ge brgya pa lan gsum bzlas pas brtan par bya'o/ /gsum pa mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/ mdun bskyed ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgyas bgegs bsal/ oṃ sha zhes dang / oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa ad+ma ko3ham̐/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ bha yongs su gyur pa las 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng rin po che'i pha gus bskor ba la steng nas dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang zhing /

mda' yab dang pu shus mdzes par byas pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang / g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang / snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan dang / 'phan la sogs pa rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol gyi 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la gnas pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo sna tshogs pa mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas 'khod pa/ de'i phyi rol khyams kha dog sna tshogs pa'i phyi rol tu 'jig rten pa'i khor yug sngon po phyi rol rdo rje'i ra ba dang / 'od zer phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'o/ /de'i nang du rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ chos kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu drug pa/ lte ba le tshe dgu pa'i phyogs bzhi nas ka ba gnyis gnyis te brgyad kyis btegs pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang / de'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bres shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje dang / rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ khang bzang gnyis kyi nang gi gzhi thams cad shar sngo/ lhor ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus kyi re mig dkar po'i dbus su seng ge'i khri/ shar du glang po che'i khri/ lhor rta'i khri/ nub tu rma bya'i khri/ byang du mkha' lding rnams kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng dang / thams cad kyi gnas su pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ phyi sgo khro bo rnams la nyi ma'i gdan/ 'jig rten pa'i khor yug la srog chags la sogs pa so so'i gdan rnams yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du oṃ sarba bid sarba a wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi dkar ba/

rtsa zhal shar du gzigs pa/ phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ shar du oṃ sarba bid hūm̐ las/ sbyong ba'i rgyal po dkar la cung zad dmar ba ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ lhor oṃ sarba bid phaṭ las rgyal mchog rin chen sngon po g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas bzhugs pa/ nub tu oṃ sarba bid a las shākya ri dbang ser po chos 'chad kyi phyag rgyas bzhugs pa/ byang du oṃ sarba bid tra tha las me tog cher rgyas ljang khu g.yas skyabs sbyin g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan dang / dar gyi na bza' can/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha lugs can no/ /shar lhor oṃ bud+dha lo tsā ni hūm̐ las spyan ma dkar mo g.yas pa spyan gyis mtshan pa'i 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu oṃ badz+ra mā ma ki tram̐ las mā ma ki sngon mo g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ nub byang du oṃ badz+ra paṇ+ḍa ri de hi de hi sid+dhi bo dhi lo ki ta ram̐ pa swāhā las gos dkar mo dmar mo g.yas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang shar du oṃ badz+ra ta re tut+ta re ru re hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swa swa swa swāhā las sgrol ma ljang khu g.yas ut+pa la 'dzin pa/ bzhi ka'ang phyag g.yon gdan la brten cing sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams dang ldan cing / nu 'bur zung gis mdzes pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi 'khor lo'i shar gyi rtsibs bzhi la rim pa bzhin du hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dzā las rdo rje rgyal po ser po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ ho las rdo rje chags pa dmar po mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ dhu las rdo rje legs pa ljang khu rdo rje se gol gyis legs so ster ba'o/ /lho'i rtsibs bzhi la/ tram̐ las rdo rje rin chen ser po g.yas rin po che dpral bar 'jog cing /

g.yon dril bu dkur 'dzin pa/ r+ya las rdo rje gzi brjid dmar ser nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ bh+ri las rdo rje rgyal mtshan nam mkha'i mdog can yid bzhin gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ ha las rdo rje bzhad pa dkar po so so'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /nub kyi rtsibs bzhi la/ hrīḥlas rdo rje chos dkar la cung zad dmar ba g.yon pad+ma 'dzin cing / g.yas pas de'i kha 'byed pa/ dhiḥlas rdo rje rnon po sngon po g.yas ral gri/ g.yon po ti 'dzin pa/ kruṃ las rdo rje rgyu ser po g.yas pa'i gung mo la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bskor zhing 'dzin pa/ bha las rdo rje smra ba dmar po rdo rje'i ljags 'dzin pa'o/ /byang gi rtsibs bzhi la/ kam̐ las rdo rje las sna tshogs mdog g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur 'dzin pa/ ram̐ las rdo rje bsrung ba ser po rdo rje'i go cha 'dzin pa/ k+ṣam̐ las rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po phyag gnyis kyi zhal gyi g.yas g.yon gyis thad khar mche ba 'dzin pa/ sam̐ las rdo rje khu tshur ser po rdo rje rtse lnga pa dam tshig gi khu tshur gyis 'dzin pa'o/ /nang gi grwa bzhir/ shar lhor hūm̐ la sgeg mo dkar mo snyems pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje gnyis 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu tram̐ las phreng ba ma ser mo phyag gnyis kyis phreng ba 'dzin pa/ nub byang du hrīḥlas glu ma dkar mo pi wang 'dzin pa/ byang shar du āḥlas gar ma ljang khu phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse gsum pa 'dzin pas gar byed pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir/ shar lhor hūm̐ las bdug pa ma dkar mo bdug spos 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu tram̐ las me tog ma dmar mo me tog gi za ma tog 'dzin pa/ nub byang du hrīḥlas mar me ma dmar skya mar me'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ byang shar du āḥlas dri chab ma ljang khu dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa'o/ /shar sgor dzaḥlas rdo rje lcags kyu dkar po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/

lho sgor hūm̐ las rdo rje zhags pa ser po zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub sgor bam̐ las rdo rje lcags sgrog dmar po lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ byang sgor hoḥlas rdo rje dril bu ljang khu dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i lha de dag thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi stod g.yog dang sham thabs can/ zhi ba'i nyams can/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang phyi ma'i lha snam dang po la phyogs bzhir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bzhi gnas pa rnams kyi steng du oṃ na mo sogs rtsa rig tshar gcig brjod la/ rtsa ba'i rig pa sbrul 'khyil ba lta bu bcu drug yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du byang chub sems dpa' byams pa/ mthong ba don yod/ ngan song kun 'dren/ mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros bzhi sku mdog sngon po/ lhor spos kyi glang po/ dpa' bar 'gro ba/ nam mkha' mdzod/ ye shes tog bzhi ser po/ nub tu 'od dpag med/ zla 'od/ bzang skyong / tra ba can gyi 'od bzhi dmar po/ byang du rdo rje snying po/ blo gros mi zad pa/ spobs pa brtsegs pa/ kun tu bzang po bzhi ljang gu thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje thugs ka dang / g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang / dar gyi gsham thabs kyis mdzes pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi lha snam gyi phyogs bzhir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bzhi gnas pa rnams kyi steng du oṃ na mo sogs rtsa rig brjod/ rtsa ba'i rig pa sbrul 'khyil ba lta bu bcu drug yongs su gyur pa las shar du 'phags pa dga' bo/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ shā ri'i bu/ mo'u 'gal gyi bu/ lhor rab 'byor/ 'char dga'/ ma 'gags pa/ ko'u di n+ya ya/ nub tu nye ba 'khor/ rta thul/ ba glang bdag

kun dga' bo/ byang du ming can/ nor 'dzin/ gang po/ 'od srung ste/ nyan thos chen po bcu drug po thams cad kyang lhun bzed 'khar sil 'dzin pa/ chos gos ngur smrig gsol zhing tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /snam bu de nyid kyi mtshams bzhi dang / phyogs bzhi'i g.yas g.yon gnyis te gnas bcu gnyis kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ na mo sogs rig brjod/ rtsa ba'i rig pa sbrul 'khyil pa lta bu bcu gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du gdung ba sel ba dang snang ba brtsegs pa/ shar lhor 'jigs pa med pa/ lhor dpa' bo 'dul ba dang shes rab mgyogs byed/ lho nub tu ri bo rgyal/ nub tu smra ba'i sgra chen dang bse ru lta bu/ nub byang du dug chen 'joms/ byang du rdzu 'phrul cher ston dang seng ge sgra/ byang shar du yid myur rnams dbu'i gtsug tor phyed dang bcas shing drang srong gi cha lugs can 'khar bsil dang po ti 'dzin pa/ chos gos bsnams shing rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /sgo phyi ma bzhi'i dbus dang g.yas g.yon gnyis/ rgyab rnams su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re ste bcu drug gi steng du oṃ na mo sogs rtsa rig brjod/ rtsa ba'i rig pa sbrul 'khyil pa lta bu bcu drug yongs su gyur pa las/ shar sgor khro bo 'jig rten gsum snang / de'i g.yas su bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ g.yon du dus kyi sring mo/ rgyab tu dus kyi lcags kyu ma/ lho sgor khro bo 'jig rten gsum 'dul/ de'i g.yas su dbyug sngon can/ g.yon du dus kyi dbyug pa ma/ rgyab tu dus kyi zhags pa ma/ nub sgor khro bo 'jig rten gsum 'ching / de'i g.yas su mi g.yo ba/ g.yon du dus kyi mtshan mo/ rgyab tu dus kyi lcags sgrog ma/ byang sgor khro bo 'jig rten gsum 'jig de'i g.yas su rta mgrin/ g.yon du dus kyi gnod sbyin mo/

rgyab tu dus kyi dril bu ma rnams sku mdog ma nges pa/ dbu dang phyag mtha' yas pa/ sbrul dang mi gdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /phyi'i khor yug gi gdan rnams kyi steng du/ oṃ na mo sogs rtsa rig brjod/ rtsa ba'i rig pa sbrul 'khyil pa lta bu re re yongs su gyur pa las/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong bcu/ dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa'i lha chen brgyad/ dga' bo dang 'jog po la sogs pa'i klu chen brgyad/ nyi ma dang zla ba la sogs pa'i gza' chen brgyad/ smin drug dang snar ma la sogs pa'i rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po la sogs pa'i rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ ma hā bhai ra wa la sogs pa 'jigs byed chen po dgu ste dpal gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / gang ba bzang po dang nor bu bzang po la sogs pa'i gnod sbyin gyi tshogs rnams dang / laṅka mgrin bcu la sogs pa'i srin po'i tshogs rnams dang / lha mo sgyu 'phrul la sogs pa'i bud med kyi tshogs rnams dang / tsar tsi ka la sogs pa'i rdo rje phra men ma'i tshogs rnams dang / wa ra hi la sogs pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams dang / gzhan yang ri'i lha dang / shing gi lha dang / grong gi lha dang / 'byung ba bzhi'i lha la sogs pa 'jig rten pa rnams kyang rang rang gi rgyan dang cha lugs dang ldan zhing so so'i g.yog 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab dang bcas pas bskor bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ de nas ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa'i phyir rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang / rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas/ spos dang bcas te/

rdo dril 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun kyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi zad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal ba grangs med du ma ru/ /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs shing / /smon lam rgya cher dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /yongs dag 'khor dang bcas rnams gshegs su gsol/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing / /nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ /dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa/ /dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/ /chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /kun tu mi zad nus par ldan/ /tshur spyon tshur byon gzhi bdag lha/ /thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen/ /shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/ /mchod pas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ bha ga wan e h+ya hi/ ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwam̐/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal ba ldan/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ /bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ga ga na sa ma ya hūm̐ swāhās mchod yon dbul/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/

/lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tha a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ gis khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs rje'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma ka ma la ya satwam̐ gyis gdan dbul/ lha la sogs pa dri yi rdzas/ /phyogs rnams kun na gang yod pa/ /tshim byed yid 'ongs ldan pa 'di/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐/ zhing 'di'am rgya chen zhing gzhan na/ /lha rdzas me tog yid 'ong ba/ /chu dang thang skyes yid byung 'di/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ phyogs dus kun nas bdug spos 'di/ /lha rdzas spos kyi shing la sogs/ /dri zhim yid 'ong gang yod pa/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra dhu pe hūm̐/ 'jig rten 'di 'am phyogs rnams na/ /lha dang mi la sogs pa'i zas/ /yon tan kun ldan gang yod de/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra nai wid+ya hūm̐/ 'jig rten 'di 'am phyogs bcu yi/ /rin chen mar me la sogs pa/ /snang ba'i khyad par gang yod de/ /thub dbang la ni dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐ gis mchod nas/ rdo rje thal mo dpral bar sbyar la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya wak+ka tsit+ta pra na mo na badz+ra ban+dha naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes pas phyag byas par mos/ sgo ma bzhi'i phyag rgya phrin bcol gyi skabs su 'byung ba ltar dang / oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa bam̐/ oṃ badz+ra a be sha āḥ zhes brjod pas aṅku shas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha rnams mdun bskyed dang nye bar dgug pā shas lha la sogs pa rnams rang rang gi gnas su gzhug s+pho ṭa bam̐ gyis lha la sogs pa phan tshun mi 'bral bar bcings/ ā be shas lha la sogs pa rang rang gi gnas su ye shes pa dang dbyer med du dbang du byas par bsam pa'o/

/de nas phyag rgya bzhis gdab cing las la sbyar ba'i phyir/ sngar gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba'i skabs su lag pa byin gyis brlabs pa de dran par byas la/ oṃ bh+ri ta sogs dpral ba dang / traṭ+ṭa traṭ+ṭa sogs mgrin pa dang / tshin+dha tshin+dha sogs snying kha sogs su phyag rgya sbyar ba gong bzhin byas pas gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ de nas rdo rje khu tshur gnyis te 'og tu kha sprad pa bkug g.yon du bzhag ngag tu/ oṃ na mo sogs rtsa rig tshar gcig bzlas pa'i tad+ya tha'i tshe phyag rgya dkrol la nu ma g.yas dang / g.yon dang / snying ka gsum du pad skor bya zhing swāhā'i bar brjod pa ni las kyi phyag rgya'o/ /de'i rjes su mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya bcings pa ni/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang / ngag tu oṃ sarba bid sarba a wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brjod pa chos kyi phyag rgya/ sngags brjod pa'i tshe mdun gyi gtso bo'i sku la gtog cing yid la bsam pa ni/ phyag rgya chen po'o/ /phyag rgya dkrol la thal mo snying khar sbyar la/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyis dmigs yul che ge mo gtso byas sems can thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song las 'don pa'i phrin las mdzod cig ces dang / ku g.yon du lag pa gnyis kas se gol gtog pa ni las la sbyar ba'o/ /che ge mo'i gnas su bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs lta bu yin na/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / zhes brjod/ cung yul gnyan pa'i rigs yin na/ sku gshegs pa 'di zhes bya ba/ gzhan rnams la tshe las 'das pa 'di zhes bya ba sogs rigs 'gre sbyar la bya'o/ /de bzhin du las rgya thun mong du gcig dang / dam tshig gi phyag rgya re dang bstun/ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ sbyong ba'i rgyal po dang / oṃ sarba bid phaṭ/ rgyal mchog rin chen dang / oṃ sarba bid a/ shākya ri dbang dang / oṃ sarba bid tra tha/ me tog cher rgyas te rigs rnam pa bzhis kyang dmigs yul che ge mo'i thog drangs sogs gong bzhin/

rtsa rig 'don pa las rgya dang / lha so so'i phyag rgya bstan pa dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang / sngags brjod pa ni chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /de'i tshe sbyong rgyal la sogs pa'i sku bsam pa ni/ phyag rgya chen po/ phyag rgya dkrol nas se gol gtog pa sogs ni las la sbyar ba'o/ /de ltar thams cad rigs 'gre shes par byas la/ oṃ bud+dha lo tsā ni hūm̐/ sangs rgyas spyan ma dang / oṃ badz+ra mā ma ki tram̐/ rdo rje mā ma ki dang / oṃ badz+ra paṇ+ḍa re de hi de hi sid+dhi bo dhi lo ki ta ram̐ pa swāhā/ gos dkar mo dang / oṃ ta re tut+ta re tu re hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swa swa swa swāhā/ sgrol ma ste/ yum rnam pa bzhis kyang dmigs yul che ge mo 'dra/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang / oṃ badz+ra rā dza dza/ rdo rje rgyal po dang / oṃ badz+ra ra ka ho/ rdo rje chags pa dang / oṃ badz+ra sā dhū dhu/ rdo rje legs pa ste shar phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang sogs 'dra/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na tram̐/ rdo rje rin chen dang / oṃ badz+ra te dz+war+ya/ rdo rje gzi brjid dang / oṃ badz+ra ke tu bh+ri/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha/ rdo rje bzhad pa ste lho phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang sogs 'dra/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā hrīḥ rdo rje chos dang / oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣa ṇa dhi/ rdo rje rnon po dang / oṃ badz+ra he tu krum̐/ rdo rje rgyu dang / oṃ badz+ra bha ṣa bha/ rdo rje smra ba ste nub phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang sogs 'dra/ oṃ badz+ra rkarmā kam̐ rdo rje las dang / oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa ram̐/ rdo rje bsrung ba dang / oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ rdo rje gnod sbyin dang / oṃ badz+ra san+dhi bam̐/ rdo rje khu tshur te byang phyogs kyis sems dpa' bzhis kyang sogs 'dra/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya hūm̐/ rdo rje sgeg mo dang / oṃ badz+ra mā le tram̐/ rdo rje phreng ba dang / oṃ badz+ra girti hrī/ rdo rje glu ma dang / oṃ badz+ra nirti āḥ

rdo rje gar ma ste nang gi lha mo bzhis kyang sogs 'dra/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe hūm̐/ rdo rje bdug spos ma dang / oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe tram̐/ rdo rje me tog ma dang / oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ rdo rje mar me ma dang / oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥ rdo rje dri chab ma ste phyi'i lha mo bzhis kyang sogs 'dra/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ rdo rje lcags kyu ma dang / oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ rdo rje zhags pa ma dang / oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa bam̐/ rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dang / oṃ badz+ra ā be sha a/ rdo rje 'bebs pa ste nang gi sgo bzhis kyang sogs 'dra/ de nas las rgya dang dam rgya song nas/ chos rgya la rtsa rig tshar gcig brjod/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams yid la bsam pa ni phyag rgya chen po'o/ /'di man la de bzhin rigs 'gre'o/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rjes la/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa/ mthong ba don yod/ ngan song kun 'dren/ mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros/ spos kyi glang po/ dpa' bar 'gro ba/ nam mkha' mdzod/ ye shes tog 'od dpag med/ zla 'od/ bzang skyong / dra ba can gyi 'od/ rdo rje snying po/ blo gros mi zad pa/ spob pa brtsegs pa/ kun tu bzang po ste bskal bzang gi sems dpa' bcu drug gis kyang sogs 'dra/ las rgya'i rtsa rig dang / chos rgya'i rtsa rig brjod la/ 'phags pa dga' bo/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ shā ri'i bu/ mau'u 'gal gyi bu/ rab 'byor/ 'char dga'/ ma 'gags pa/ ko'u ḍi n+ya ya/ nye ba 'khor/ rta thul/ ba glang bdag kun dga' bo/ ming chen/ nor 'dzin/ gang po/ 'od srung ste nyan thos chen po bcu drug gis kyang sogs 'dra/ las rgya dang chos rgya'i rtsa rig gnyis brjod la/ gdung ba sel ba/ snang ba brtsegs pa/ 'jigs pa med pa/ dpa' bo 'dul ba/ shes rab mgyogs chen/ ri bo rgyal/ smra ba'i sgra chen/ bse ru lta bu/ dug chen 'joms/ rdzu 'phrul cher ston/ seng ge sgra/ yid myur te rang rgyal chen po bcu gnyis kyis kyang sogs 'dra/

las rgya chos rgya'i rtsa rig gnyis brjod/ khro bo bzhi/ pho nya bzhi/ mngags pa bzhi/ bran bzhi ste phyi'i sgo ba chen po bcu drug gis kyang dmigs yul che ge mos gtso byas sems can thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song las 'don pa'i phrin las mdzod cig las rgya dang chos rgya'i rtsa rig gnyis brjod cing / dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa'i lha rnams dang rtsa rig gnyis brjod/ dga' bo dang 'jog po la sogs pa'i klu rnams dang / rtsa rig gnyis brjod/ gang ba bzang po dang nor bu bzang po la sogs pa'i gnod sbyin rnams dang / rtsa rig gnyis brjod/ laṅka mgrin bcu la sogs pa'i srin po rnams dang / rtsa rig gnyis brjod/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul la sogs pa'i bud med rnams dang / rtsa rig gnyis brjod/ nyi ma dang zla ba la sogs pa'i gza' rnams dang / rtsa rig gnyis brjod/ snar ma dang smin drug la sogs pa'i rgyu skar rnams dang / rtsa rig gnyis brjod/ tsar tsi ka la sogs pa'i rdo rje phra men ma rnams dang / rtsa rig gnyis brjod/ wa ra hi la sogs pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams dang / rtsa rig gnyis brjod/ phyogs skyong bcu/ rgyal chen bzhi/ 'jigs byed dgu chung ma dang bcas pa dang / dbang phyug chung ma dang bcas pa dang / drag po chung ma dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang ri'i lha dang / shing gi lha dang / grong gi lha dang / 'byung ba bzhi'i lha mdor na lo dang zhag dang dus kyi lha la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis byang chub ma thob bar gyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod cig ces brjod/ gzhan phan mtha' yas las byang sems nyan rang man chad la las rgya'i rtsa rig dang / chos rgya'i rtsa rig gnyis ma chad pa gal che'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dbang phyug chen po man chad kyi 'jig rten pa rnams la las rgya'i rtsa rig chad par mngon pas/ rtsa rig gnyis brjod/ ces gsal bar bstan pa 'di thams cad kyi thugs gzhis bcug nas ma chad pa mdzad dgos so/

/thams cad la las rgya/ dam rgya/ chos rgya/ phyag rgya chen po ste phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab cing las la sbyar ba ma chad pa gal che/ phyag rgya chen po'i don gzhan rnams ni rtogs par sla la/ 'jig rten pa rnams kyi sku yid la byed pa ni/ 'jig rten 'dir rang gis yid la ci dang ci 'dod pa thams cad 'grub pa'i las dang / byang chub ma thob bar gyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las gzhol ba yin no/ /de dag gi phyag rgya ni/ lag pa g.yon pa pang khar gan rkyal du bzhag g.yas de'i steng du bzhag ste mthe bong gnyis ngo sprad pa ni/ gtso bo kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi dam rgya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo dang mthe bong mthe'u chung bzhi sbyar la bsgreng / mdzub mo dang srin lag pad+ma 'dra bar byas pa ni ngan song sbyong ba'i dam rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub mo dang srin lag gi tshigs bar pa bcag la rin po che 'dra bar byas pa ni/ rgyal mchog gi dam rgya'o/ /mthe bong dang mthe'u chung gnyis so sor sbyar la/ lhag ma 'bar bar byas pa ni shākya ri dbang gi dam rgya'o/ /de nyid g.yon du bsgyur ba ni me tog cher rgyas kyi dam rgya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis rtse sprad mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i logs la mig 'dra bar sbyar srin lag mthe chung nang du bcug pa'i steng mthe bong gnyis kyis mnan pa ni spyan ma'i dam rgya'o/ /thal mo sbyar ba las mthe'u chung nang du bcug mdzub mo gnyis rdo rje'i ra ltar gung mo la ma reg par byas pa ni/ mā ma ki'i dam rgya/ thal mo sbyar ba las gung mo gnyis pad+ma ltar byas la/ mthe'u chung gnyis so sor cung zad phral ba ni gos dkar mo'i dam rgya/ thal mo sbyar ba las mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab nas dkris/ mthe bong gnyis gung mo la sbyar/ lhag ma rtse mo bsnol ba ni sgrol ma'i dam rgya/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis brkyang ba rdo rje rtse gcig pa 'dra bar byas pa ni/

rdo rje sems dpa'i dam rgya/ de nyid las mdzub mo g.yon pa'i logs nas lcags kyu ltar byas pa ni/ rdo rje rgyal po'i dam rgya/ de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis mda'i stong ltar kha cung zad phye ste sbyar ba ni/ rdo rje chags pa'i dam rgya'o/ /de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis bkug ste mthe bong gnyis la sbyar nas se gol gtog pa lta bu ni/ rdo rje legs pa'i dam rgya/ de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis rtse sbyar te tshigs bar ma bcag pa rin po che 'dra bar byas pa ni/ rdo rje rin chen gyi dam rgya/ de nyid las sor mo lhag ma rnams gyen du cung zad gzengs pa 'od zer 'bar ba ltar byas pa ni/ rdo rje gzi brjid kyi dam rgya/ de nyid spyi bor bzhag cing cung zad bskor ba ni/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi dam rgya/ de nyid spyi bor bzhag cing kha'i thad khar sbyar te phyir cung zad brkyang ba ni/ rdo rje bzhad pa'i dam rgya/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis pad+ma 'dra bar byas pa ni/ rdo rje chos kyi dam rgya/ de nyid las/ mdzub mo gnyis brkyang tshigs rtse mo bcag ste ral gri'i so 'dra bar byas pa ni rdo rje rnon mo'i dam rgya/ de nyid las/ mdzub mo gnyis kyi tshigs bar pa bcag ste/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs 'dra bar byas pa rdo rje rgyu'i dam rgya/ de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis pad+ma ltar byas pa'i rtse mo cung zad kha phye ba ni/ rdo rje smra ba'i dam rgya/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong dang mthe'u chung mdzub mo gsum rtse sprad de brkyang ba ni/ rdo rje las kyi dam rgya/ de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis cung zad kha phye ba/ rdo rje bsrung ba'i dam rgya/ de nyid las mthe bong gnyis brkyang ba mdzub mo gnyis mche ba ltar brkyang ba rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi dam rgya/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong gnyis nang du bkug de'i rgyab nas mdzub mo gnyis kyis mnan pa ni/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi dam rgya/

rdo rje thal mo snying khar sbyar ba ni/ rdo rje sgeg mo'i dam rgya/ de nyid dpral bar brkyangs pa ni/ rdo rje phreng ba'i dam rgya/ de nyid khar reg ste phyir brkyangs te dbyung ba'i tshul ni/ rdo rje glu ma'i dam rgya/ de nyid spyi bor bskor ba ni/ rdo rje gar ma'i dam rgya/ rdo rje bsdams pa kha phub ste mdun du bzhag pa ni/ bdug spos ma'i dam rgya/ de nyid las gyen du me tog 'thor ba'i tshul ni/ me tog ma'i dam rgya/ de nyid las mthe bong gnyis mnyam pa bsgrengs te mdun du bskor ba ni/ mar me'i dam rgya/ thal mo phyir bstan te byug pa byas pa ni/ dri ma'i dam rgya/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse lcags kyu ltar bkug pa ni/ lcags kyu ma yi dam rgya/ de las rtse mo gnyis sbyar te zhags mig ltar byas pa ni/ zhags pa ma'i dam rgya/ de nyid las mtheb mdzub gnyis gcig la gcig 'khyud pa ste lcags sgrog ltar byas pa ni/ lcags sgrog ma'i dam rgya/ de nyid las mthe bong gnyis nang du bcug ste cung zad bskyod pa ni/ dril bu ma yi dam rgya/ thal mo sbyar ba las gung mo dang srin lag sbyar mthe chung nang du bcug mthe bong gnyis kyi rtser mdzub mo gnyis bkug ste sbyar ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa' spyi'i dam rgya/ thal mo snying khar sbyar ba ni/ nyan thos spyi'i dam rgya/ g.yon khu tshur nang du bstan te mtheb mdzub sbyar ba bsgrengs/ g.yas kyi mtheb srin sbyar te bsgreng ba/ g.yon gyi mtheb mdzub steng du bzhag mdzub mo sogs lhag ma gsum brkyangs pa ni/ rang rgyal rnams kyi dam rgya/ rdo rje bsdams pa nang du bcings pa las gung mo gnyis rtse sprad de brkyangs/ tha ma bzhi so sor kha phye la bskyed de bsgrengs pa ni/ 'jig rten gsum snang la sogs pa'i khro bo bcu'i dam rgya/ thal mo sbyar ba las dbus ma gsum rtse sprad de tshigs bar ma gsum bcag tha ma bzhi bskyed pa ni lha rnams kyi dam rgya/

thal mo sbyar ba las gung mo/ /gnyis gshibs te sbyar ba'i rgyab tu mdzub mo gnyis ma reg par rdo rje ltar bkug mthe bong gnyis gshibs la bsgrengs srin lag dang mthe'u chung rnams bsnol ba ni/ klu rnams kyi dam rgya/ lag pa gnyis gyen du kha phye ste gshibs pa'i sor mo rnams so ltar gshibs te mdzub mo gnyis cung zad mtho bar mche ba ltar brkyangs pa ni/ gnod sbyin rnams kyi dam rgya'o/ /g.yas pa'i snyim pa kha phyir bstan pa mgo tshal gyi phyag rgya ston pa ni/ srin po rnams kyi dam rgya/ g.yon gyi snyem pa g.yas kyi 'khrig ma'i 'og thad du kha gyen du bstan te mgo tshal bshags pa lta bur deng sang phyag len la mdzad pa de ltar byas na'ang 'gal ba med dam bsam mo/ /sor mo bcu phan tshun bsnol ba zhes pa ni rdo rje thal mo snying khar sbyar ba ni/ bud med rnams kyi dam rgya/ g.yon khu tshur snying khar sbyar la/ g.yas dbyug pa 'dzin pa ltar mdzub mo bsgreng ba ni/ gza' rnams kyi dam rgya las mthe bong gnyis mdun du bkan pa'i gung mo gnyis bkug pa ni/ rgyu skar rnams kyi dam rgya/ lag pa gnyis kyi sor mo bcu rtse bkug ste sprad pa'i snyim pa ni/ phra men ma rnams kyi dam rgya/ de nyid las mthe bong gnyis lce ltar cung zad skyod pa rnams ni/ rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi dam rgya/ thal mo sbyar ba brkyangs la pad skor byas te thal mo sbyar ba kha phye ba ni/ phyogs skyong sogs 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi dam rgya thun mong ba'o/ /de nas mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs pa gong gi mchod pa byin rlabs ltar byas la/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ thal mo sbyar nas/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang / /bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di/ /ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na/ /thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis/

/ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang / /sems can don kun mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+gham̐ pra tits+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod yon dang / de bzhin tshigs bcad dang / sngags gong 'og thams cad 'dra bar byas la/ me tog ji snyed yod pa dang / puṣ+pe/ bdug spos dang / dhu pe/ snang gsal dang / ā lo ke dri chab dang / gan+dhe/ zhal zas dang / ne wi d+yam̐/ rol mo ji snyed yod pa dang / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shab+ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes dang / gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs kyis sna tshogs rol mo dbul/ de nas mchod pa nyer lnga bya ste/ lag gnyis pad skor sngon du 'gro bas khu tshur rang gi mgo'i steng du dbang bskur ba'i tshul du 'jog cing / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na mu ku tra pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing spyi bor lha la rin po che'i cod pan bcings par bsam/ sngags gong 'og 'dra ba las/ mu ku tra'i gnas su rat+na kuṇ+ḍa la/ zhes dang / pad skor bya zhing rna rgyan gdags pa'i tshul dang / rat+na ra ṣa/ zhes pas mgul rgyan/ rat+na a wa ha ra zhes pas do shal dang / rat+na ke yu ra zhes pas dpung rgyan gnyis dang / rat+na pa ri ka ṭa kaṃ zhes pas 'khrigs ma gnyis su gdub bu dang / rat+na pa kaṃ wa la zhes pas gung gnyis la sor gdub/ pā da bha ṇa zhes pas rkang pa g.yas g.yon gyi bol la rkang rgyan rnams gnas de dang der 'dogs pa'i tshul byed/ lag pa g.yon de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur byas pa'i mthe bo'i steng du lag pa g.yas pa'i thal mo kha phub ste gdug phub pa'i tshul du byas la tsha traṃ ka zhes brjod/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis brtsegs nas dpung pa g.yon phyogs su rgyal mtshan 'khur ba'i tshul dang / dh+wa dza zhes brjod/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis nam mkha' la 'phan 'dogs pa'i tshul dang / pa taṃ ka zhes brjod/ lag g.yon khu tshur snying khar bzhag

g.yas pa'i khu tshur bcangs pa las mdzub mo gnyis brkyangs nas nam mkha' la lda ldi 'dogs pa'i tshul dang / pa ṭa da ma zhes brjod/ lag gnyis thal mos rnga yab g.yob pa'i tshul dang / tsa ma ra zhes brjod/ lag pa g.yon mnyam bzhag dang g.yas pa smin mtshams nas kha phub te bstan la/ bla bre dbul bar bsams te wi ta nam zhes brjod/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis gshibs te mdun du brkyangs la seng ge'i gdan dbul ba'i tshul dang / siṃha a sa na zhes brjod/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis g.yas g.yon du cung zad bskyod de/ gzim chas g.yog pa'i tshul bya zhing / sha ya sarbān zhes brjod/ lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur snying khar bzhag g.yas pa'i khu tshur las mdzub mo dang gung mo gnyis brkyangs te mdun du zlum por bskor ba pho brang zlum por bskor ba'i tshul dang / pa ri maṇ+ḍal dha ni/ zhes brjod/ phyag rgya de nyid kyis mdun du zur bzhi'i thad khar badha tsam gyis pho brang gru bzhi 'bul ba'i tshul dang / a me ya tsa tu ra/ zhes brjod/ yang phyag rgya de nyid kyi pho brang gru bzhi nyis brtsegs 'bul ba'i tshul dang / dwi ku ṭa gam̐ zhes brjod/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha gyen du bstan nas zla ba'i gdan 'bul ba'i tshul dang / tsaṇ+ḍa a sa na zhes brjod/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis me tog 'thor ba'i tshul dang / puṣ+pe zhes brjod/ lag gnyis pi wang dang ting shags brdung ba'i tshul dang / wi ni zhes brjod/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur snying khar bzhag g.yas pas rdo rje khu tshur gyis dri'i phye ma 'gyed pa'i tshul dang / gan+dhe zhes brjod/ thal mo gnyis kha gyen du bstan lha bshos 'bul ba'i tshul dang / nai wi daṃ zhes brjod/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis gos zung 'bul ba'i tshul byas te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta waṣ+ṭa pū dza mā+e gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa ni lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pas na/

oṃ badz+ra la s+ya hūm̐ zhes dang / pad skor sngon du 'gro bas lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur byas pa dku'i rta zur gnyis su bsten pa sgeg mo'i 'o/ /rdo rje rin chen bla na med/ /oṃ badz+ra mā le tram̐/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis smin mtshams g.yas g.yon gyi thad khar phreng ba 'dzin pa'i tshul bya ba ni phreng ba ma'i 'o/ /rdo rje chos kyi glu blangs pa/ /oṃ badz+ra girti hrīḥ khu tshur gnyis kyi kha nas tshig dbyung ba'i tshul bya zhing / mdun du brkyang ba glu ma'i 'o/ /rdo rje las kun byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra nirti āḥ rdo rje thal mo spyi bor bzhag ste g.yas su bskor ba ni gar ma'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra sa twa su saṃ gra haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe hūm̐/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis phub pa ni bdug spos ma'i 'o/ /badz+ra rat+na ma nu tā raṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe traṃ/ rdo rje tshur gnyis gyen du me tog 'thor ba'i tshul byed pa me tog ma'i 'o/ /badz+ra dharmā ga ya ni/ oṃ badz+ra a lo ke hrīḥ rdo rje khu tshur las mthe bong gnyis gshibs te bsgrengs pa mar me'i 'o/ /badz+ra karmā ka ro bha we/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥ thal mo gnyis gshibs te brkyangs pa kha phyir bstan te dri byug pa ltar bya ba dri chab ma'i 'o/ /de dag ni gsang ba'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas oṃ las rin po che sna bdun sprul par bsam ste/ oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ra sū ra sū ra a warta ya warta ya hoḥ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra rat+na pū tsi te hūm̐/ rgyal sras dang bcas rnams la/ /nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas/ /bkren cing 'phongs pa rgyun bcad de/ /'byor ba phun sum tshogs par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi rat+na pu tsi te hūm̐/ zhes pa 'gre/ btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de/

/shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /wasti rat+naྎ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan/ /bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing / /yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /ma hā sta rat+naྎ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas/ /bla med theg pa rab zhon te/ /thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /hasti rat+naྎ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro bar shog /tu raṅga a shwa rat+naྎ dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas/ /nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas/ /phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de/ /snyem bral mchog nyid thob par shog /khat+ga rat+naྎ zhes brjod cing dbul/ de la lag pa gnyis 'khrig ma bsnol te rgyab sbyar la sor mo rnams phan tshun 'khyud nas mthe bong gnyis lag mthil du bkag pa ni/ 'khor lo'i 'o/ /khu tshur gnyis sbyar ba'i mdzub mo gnyis rtse sprad pa'i tshigs bcag la mthe bong gnyis dang sbyar ba ni/ nor bu'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis bsgrengs pa'i logs la mdzub mo gnyis sbyar te bzhag pa ni/ btsun mo'i 'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo dang mtha' bzhi gshibs te bsgrengs pa ni/ glang po'i 'o/ /g.yas glang po'i sna ltar brkyangs pa'i gru mo g.yon pas bzung ba ni/ glang po'i 'o/ /khu tshur gnyis gshibs la gung mo gnyis dang srin lag gnyis brkyangs la rtse sbyar mthe bong gnyis rna ba ltar byas pa/ rta'i 'o/ /g.yon pa go cha 'dzin pa'i tshul byas la/ g.yas mchog sbyin bya ba ni/ dmag dpon gyi phyag rgya'o/ /de nas 'dod yon lnga dbul te/ kha tog dbyibs legs yid 'ongs rgyan phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun nas gzugs mchog ci mchis pa/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyi/ /bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa kā ma gu na pū tsi te hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ phyogs dus kun nas zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /yon tan tshim mchog sgra snyan ci mchis pa/ /mos blosྎ bzhes shigྎ shab+daྎ phyogs dus kun nas tsan+dan sbrul snying dang / /a kar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /mos blosྎ bzhes shigྎ gan+dham̐ྎ phyogs dus kun nas ro dang bcud ldan pa'i/ /lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis pa/ /mos blosྎ bzhes shigྎ ra saྎ phyogs dus kun nas 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i/ /reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams/ /mos blosྎ bzhes shigྎ par+ṣeྎ zhes pas mchod/ 'dod yon lnga'i gzugs kyi phyag rgya ni/ snyim pa sbyar te me long ngam/ rdo rje lta bu bzung ba'o/ /ma bzung yang snyim par sbyar te/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas mchod/ sgra ni dril bu sogs rol mo sna tshogs dbul ba/ dri'i phyag rgya ni dri mchog 'bul ba ltar bya/ ro'i phyag rgya ni gtor ma 'bul ba ltar lag gnyis sor mo bsnol mthe bong gnyis mdzub mo'i rtsa bar bzhag pa'o/ /reg bya ni/ gos zung 'bul ba'i tshul byed do/ /de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dbyangs snyan pos bstod de/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /rnam par snang mdzad bcos ldan 'das/ /ting nge 'dzin ldan phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal bcom ldan gang zhig la/ /me long ye shes rang bzhin las/ /sems can ma lus thams cad kyi/ /ngan song thams cad sbyong mdzad pa/ /phyag 'tshal sbyong ba'i rgyal po la/ /mnyam nyid ye shes yon tan bdag /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen gyis/ /sems can bsam pa skong mdzad pa/ /rgyal mchog rin chen khyod phyag 'tshal/ /so sor kun rtog gsung gi bdag /gsung rab pad+ma kha rgyas pa/ /khams gsum dbugs dbyung mdzad pa po/ /shākya ri dbang khyod phyag 'tshal/ /nan tan ye shes 'phrin las bdag /sna tshogs sems can sdug bsngal kun/ /ma lus pa ni zhi mdzad pa/

/me tog cher rgyas khyod phyag 'tshal/ /grwa yi phyogs ni kun tu yang / /rigs kyi yum bzhi skur bstan pa/ /lha mo spyan dang mā ma ki /dkar mo sgrol ma khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rtsibs kyi nang ni thams cad na/ /bzhugs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /rdzu 'phrul che ba'i sems dpa' rnams/ /rgyud bzhin bdag gis bstod par bgyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang / /phyag 'tshal phyag na rdo rje la/ /rdo rje rgyal po sangs rgyas mchog /rdo rje lcags kyu de bzhin gshegs/ /don yod rgyal po rdo rje mchog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'gugs khyod la/ /rdo rje chags pa bde chen po/ /rdo rje mda' ni dbang byed pa/ /bdud kyi 'dod pa rdo rje che/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje gzhu khyod la/ /rdo rje legs pa sems dpa' mchog /rdo rje mgu ba dga' ba che/ /rab dgyes rgyal po rdo rje mchog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dgyes khyod la/ /rdo rje rin chen rdo rje'i don/ /rdo rje nam mkha' nor bu che/ /nam mkha'i snying po rdo rje phyug /phyag 'tshal rdo rje snying khyod la/ /rdo rje bzhad mo bzhad pa che/ /rdo rje 'dzum pa ngo mtshar che/ /dga' zhing rab dga' rdo rje ston/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dga' ba la/ /rdo rje chos rab de nyid dang / /rdo rje pad+ma rab dga' byed/ /'jig rten dbang rab rdo rje can/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje can khyod la/ /rdo rje rno ba theg pa che/ /rdo rje ral gri mtshon chen po/ /'jam dpal rdo rje rab tu zab/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje blo khyod la/ /rdo rje rgyud dang snying po che/ /rdo rje 'khor lo tshul chen po/ /rab skor rdo rje las byung ba/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje snying po la/ /rdo rje gsung ba rab rib mchog /rdo rje bzlos pa rab bsgrub phyir/ /mi gsung rdo rje mchog bsgrub pa/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje gsung khyod la/

/rdo rje las rab rdo rje'i bka'/ /las kyi rdo rje kun rab 'gro/ /rdo rje nges pa rgya che ba/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje kun khyod la/ /rdo rje bsrung ba brtan pa che/ /rdo rje go cha sra ba che/ /brtson 'grus mchog ni thub pa dka'/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje brtson 'grus la/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin thabs chen po/ /rdo rje mche ba 'jigs pa che/ /bdud 'joms rdo rje mi zad pa/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje drag po la/ /rdo rje mtshams sbyor rab tu nyid/ /rdo rje 'ching ba rab grol byed/ /rdo rje khu tshur dam tshig mchog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje khu tshur la/ /rnam dag rdo rje thugs 'dzin ma/ /mi dmigs rdo rje ting 'dzin gnas/ /rdo rje sgeg mo'i tshul 'dzin ma/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'gying ma la/ /rnam dag rdo rje yon tan te/ /yid bzhin rdo rje re ba skong / /rdo rje gzugs kyi tshul 'dzin ma/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje phreng ba la/ /rnam dag rdo rje'i gsung mchog ma/ /rdo rje pi wang 'dzin pa'i tshul/ /rdo rje gsung dbyangs sgrog pa'i don/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dbyangs mkhan la/ /rnam dag rdo rje las rab ster/ /las kyi rdo rje 'gro don mdzad/ /bdud 'dul rdo rje'i phyag rgya 'dzin/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje gar mkhan ma/ /sprin bzhin rdo rje bdug pa ma/ /tshim byed rdo rje dang ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje phreng ba'i tshul 'dzin ma/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje bdug pa la/ /rdo rje mdzes pa'i tshul 'dzin cing / /rdo rje me tog 'thor ba'i tshul/ /byang chub yan lag me tog ste/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje me tog la/ /'od gsal rdo rje 'bar ba'i me/ /rdo rje spyan gyis ma rig sel/ /rdo rje gsal byed phyag rgya 'dzin/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje snang byed la/ /rdo rje tsan+dan bdud rtsi'i chu/ /rdo rje dri yi rnam rtog 'joms/ /rdo rje dag byed phyag rgya 'dzin/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dri mchog la/ /rnam dag skul byed rdo rje'i don/

/rdo rje bdud mdzad rdo rje'i don/ /rdo rje 'gugs byed phyag rgya 'dzin/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje lcags kyu la/ /mi stong rdo rje chos kyi don/ /rdo rje 'dren pa mi 'gyur don/ /'ching mdzad rdo rje phyag rgya 'dzin/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje zhags pa la/ /rdo rje mi 'gyur brtan pa'i bdag /rdo rje mgyogs byed glog bzhin 'gyu/ /sgrog mdzad rdo rje'i phyag rgya 'dzin/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje lcags sgrog la/ /rdo rje dbab pa brtan pa'i bdag /bskyod mdzad rdo rje kun gyi las/ /rdo rje dbab pa'i phyag rgya 'dzin/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'bebs pa la/ /sgo yi khyams na bzhugs pa yi/ /byams pa la sogs bcu drug ni/ /rab dga' la sogs gnas mdzad pa'i/ /byang sems rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pa'i rtags 'chang nyan thos mchog /lhung bzed mkhar bsil po ti phyag /bslab sbyangs yon tan kun ldan pa'i/ /nyan thos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'brel don la rten gnas pa'i/ /'phags pa rang rgyal bcu gnyis ni/ /'byung dang ldog la rab bzhugs pa'i/ /rang rgyal gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro bo srin po'i cha lugs can/ /sbrul dang mi gdug mgos brgyan pa'i/ /stag lpags kyis ni rnam dkris pa'i/ /'jig rten gsum snang sogs phyag 'tshal/ /phyi yi khor yug la gnas pa'i/ /'jigs byed lha klu gza' skar dang / /phyogs skyong rgyal chen phyag 'tshal zhing / /'jig rten pa kun bstod par bgyi/ /zhes pas bstod/ 'di'i phyag rgya rnams mtho ling gser gyi lha khang na lo chen gyis bzhengs pa'i kun rig gi lha rnams kyi bzhugs tshul dang phyag mtshan 'dzin tshul rnams rdo rje 'chang chen pos tshigs bcad du mdzad pa bzhin shes par bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma rnams chus bran la/ gtor ma dang po phyogs skyong la 'bul ba ni/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsang / rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang /

oṃ badz+ra dzā la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭ/ rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ces brjod/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya snying khar bskor zhing / oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ ad+ya nut+pan twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo dril 'dzin pas/ phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba dbang dang ldan/ /snying rje thabs mkhas thugs dam dkyil po che/ /lha dang drang srong yi dwags srin po klu/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po dang ni gnod sbyin bdag /de dag so so'i dbang po'i skur ston cing / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba bzhugs so 'tshal/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wa ra e h+ya hi/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwam̐ gyis gdan dbul/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas dam la bzhag cing / oṃ in+d+ra ya/ ag+na ye/ ya ma ye/ nai re t+ya ya/ wa ru ṇa ya/ wa ya we/ ku bhe ra ya/ i shwa ra ya/ ud+dha bra ha ma/ sur+ya bra ma/ a dhi pa ta ye/ tsan+d+ra nak+ṣa tra/ a dhi pa ta ye/ a to pri thi wi bh+yaḥ na ge bh+yaḥ sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya satwam̐/ zhes brjod/ yang oṃ in+d+ra ye nas sa ma ya satwam̐ gyi bar dang / oṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ pā daṃ swāhā/ puṣ+paṃ swāhā/ dhu paṃ swāhā/ dī paṃ swāhā/ gan+dhaṃ swāhā/ zhes pas mchod nas/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/

/mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha/ /ma mo'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho nub gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /klu yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub byang gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /gnod sbyin lag na dbyug tho thogs/ /nor skyong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /'byung po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang shar gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang / /nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po/ /gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /'og gi klu de sa yi bdag /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang / /dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod/ de nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ in+d+ra ya nas sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya satwam̐/ zhes pa'i mthar/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tha khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba lin+ta ye swāhā/ zhes pa gsum gyis gtor ma phul nas/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang / /dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang / /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang /

/lha rnams kun dang gang dag sa steng klu/ /ri yi lha dang gtsang ma'i tshogs bcas la/ /sa sa so sor gtor ma phul ba 'di/ /rab tu dgyes pa'i yid kyis bzhes nas su/ /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas kyang / /rang gi bud med mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun bcas/ /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs gcig tu/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas kyang / /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas bstan/ /rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs/ /sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /thams cad du ni sdom pa legs/ /thams cad bsrung ba'i dge slong dag /sdug bsngal kun las de grol lo/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes kyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skyes/ /srung ma dam tshig can khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi chos sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bsam don chos ldan yid bzhin du bsgrub par mdzad du gsol/ mtheb srin gyi se gol kha phyir bstan nas gdab ste/ da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ gtor ma gnyis pa 'byung po spyi la 'bul ba ni/

yak+ṣas bsang ba nas/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ces pa'i bar gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas/ lha klu 'byung po'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grub/ /nam mkha' lding dang zla bzang lus hrul po/ /dri za srin po gdon gyi tshogs rnams dang / /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bud med bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa la/ /bdag gis pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni/ /thal mo sbyar nas khyed la gsol 'debs kyi/ /gsan nas phan gdags slad du 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ sarba lo kā ka ra e h+ya hi/ pad+ma ka mā la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pad+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ swāhā/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ de wā/ na ga yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa ya/ gan+dha ra bha/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ ki ṇa ra/ ma ho ra ga ma nu ṣ+ya/ a ma nu ṣ+ya/ sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba lin+ta ye swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang / /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang / /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang / /ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang / /rin chen gling na lhag par gang gnas dang / /chu bo kun dang chu bo'i mdo rnams dang / /mtsho dang rdzing bu lteng ka chu ngogs dang / /g.ya' chu bsil ma can na gang gnas dang / /grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong pa dang / /khang stong dag dang lha yi gnas rnams dang / /gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas rnams dang / /dka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres rnams dang / /rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang / /lam srang sum mdo dang ni bzhi mdo dang / /gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung / /dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang / /seng ge dred dang gcan gzan gnas rnams dang /

/'brog chen 'jigs su rung ba gang gnas dang / /gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang / /lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa dang / /rab tu dgyes shing mgu bar gyur nas su/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas kyang / /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /zhes pa nas/ 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skyes/ /zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin dang / lha klu 'byung po'i tshogs khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi chos bsgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba lo ka kā ra gṛh+ṇa daṃ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ gats+tsha zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ gtor ma gsum pa bsil gtor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin dang / se gol gtog cing / na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lā+o ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ zhes bdun brjod la thal mo sbyar te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzugs mdzad dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku 'jam klas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid rigs drug gi sems can la sbyin no/ /rang rang so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa 'byung bar gyur cig thams cad sdug bsngal las grol te myur du sangs rgya bar gyur cig ces pas rigs drug dang / bzhi pa bsil gtor 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ na maḥsarba sogs gtor sngags bdun/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang sogs de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod pa gong bzhin byas la/
