mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di yi dwags kyi 'gro ba thams cad la sbyin no/ /gnod pa med par tshim nas bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal las grol te myur du sangs rgya bar gyur cig ces brjod/ gtor ma lnga pa bgegs gtor ni/ rang nyid khro bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa kro dha zhes tshar gcig brjod/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang / chos kyi bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bden pa/ gsang sngags dang rigs sngags kyi bden pa/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad skad cig thang cig yud tsam la 'dir mchis par gyur cig ces dang / ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥlan gsum/ oṃ gung ka re/ gung ka re swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swāhā/ oṃ gung gung swāhā/ sarba bigh+nan/ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+gham̐ swāhā/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ gad+dhaṃ swāhā/ zhes pa'i phyag rgya rnams lag pa g.yas kho nas bya zhing g.yon rdo rje khu tshur snying kar sbyar/ oṃ gung ka re nas/ oṃ gung gung swāhā'i bar dang / sarba bigh+nan na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ nas ba lin+ta ye swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar sngags gnyis ka gong bzhin lan gsum/ de nas rdo rje snying kha dang / dril bu chig brdung bya zhing / gang zhig mtshan mo rgyu ba yi/ /'byung po rnams dang sha za dang / /srin po sha rjen za ba dang / /sems can rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /ljon shing gel ba sogs gnas dang / /de dang de la gtor ma ni/ /bza' ba sha chang la phug bcas/ /'bras chan 'bras bu mang po yi/ /mchod sbyin 'di yis mgu byos la/ /gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan pa yis/

/de ring phyin chad bskyed par bgyi/ /rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing / /dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod/ /'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ste/ /dge slong dge sbyong de yis bram ze de/ /mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med/ /'chi ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzems/ /'tsho ba'i zas la kun kyang 'du/ /rang gi lus la dpe longs la/ /gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /oṃ chen po'am chung ngu gang dag gis/ /lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa/ /nad de nye bar phyung nas su/ /gdon de rang gi gnas su dengs/ /de ltar bdag gis ci nus kyis/ /mchod dang bsnyen bkur byas pa yis/ /dam tshig gnas la gnas nas su/ /bdag gi bsam pa bkang bar mdzod/ /rtag tu dam tshig la gnas shing / /'dir ni bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad de rab tu sol mdzod la/ /gdon khyod rang gi gnas su dengs/ /oṃ sarba bigh+nan gats+tsha/ zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ gtor ma phyi rol tu dor zhing rol mo drag tu byas la/ na maḥs man+ta ka ya wak+ka tsit+ta badz+ra ṇaṃ/ na mo badz+ra kro dha ya/ ma hā daṃṣ+ṭota/ ka twa bhe ra wa ya/ a si mu pa la pa ri shud pa hasta ya/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/ bi s+pho ṭa ya/ bi s+pho ṭa ya/ ma hā na ga pa ti/ dzi wi ta/ an+ta ka ra ya swāhā/ mtshams bcad 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma 'bul ba'o/ /yang cha gsum gtor ma zur du gtong dgos byung na/ rigs drug dang yi dwags kyi bsil gtor bzhag ste/ phyogs skyong nas bgegs gtor gyi bar btang bas don tshang ba yod/ bzhi pa bdag 'jug blang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rang gi kun rig gi dbang bskur zhus pa'i bla ma dang tha mi dad par mos la/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su 'dug nas dbang zhu bar bsam la/ bum chu nas 'thung zhing / ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /sogs dang / a bhi ṣe ka ta'i sngags brjod cing gdong bkrus par bsam/

de nas maṇ+ḍal gyi gnas bsrung steng du bum chu thigs pa gcig blugs la/ maṇ+ḍal bdun ma spyi dang mthun par phul la/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid ni bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gtso bo tha mi dad pa la sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /ces lan gsum brjod pas kha bkang / rgyun bshags ni/ dbang med bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa dang / /rjes su yi rang yang na bgyid stsal gang / /de dag thams cad byang chub mchog gi ni/ /spyan sngar da lta ma lus so sor bshags/ /bde gshegs sras kyi tshogs gnyis zab pa dang / /rgya chen 'gro ba ma lus pa yi don/ /sgrub par byed dang de las gzhan pa la'ang / /rtag tu bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo / /thugs rje khyab pa'i thugs dang ldan gyur cing / /blo gros sdig bral gti mig tshogs kun bcom/ /ma lus rigs kyi pad+ma'i nang zhugs pa/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /blo mchog rnams kyi kun dga' ra ba ste/ /dman pas 'jigs pa nyid kyi rgyal byed tshal/ /srid pa'i 'byor ba zil gyis gnon pa'i mchog /gsung mchog chos la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /'dod chags la sogs sbrul gyi dug bcom zhing / /blo gros rnam rgyal thugs rje ldan pa yi/ /brtul zhugs bzang po'i tshogs la skyabs mchi zhing / /srid dang bral ba rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rgyu yi rjes la bdag po'i yul bdag nyid/ /'bras bu'i stobs kyis dgra las rgyal gyur pa'i/

/snying rje'i rtsa ba zug cing yang dag rtogs/ /mnyam med byang chub sems ni gzung bar bgyi/ /sems can rnams ni yongs su smin pa'am/ /yang na yongs su skyabs pa bya phyir ram/ /rang gi sems nyid dag par bya ba'i phyir/ /'di dag thams cad rtswa sogs bzhin du btang / /de bzhin tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus dang / /bsam gtan shes rab bla na med pa 'di/ /bdag dang gzhan la phan par bya ba'i phyir/ /skad cig re re zhing yang bsgom par bgyi/ /bde bar gshegs pa sngags la mkhas pa yi/ /chos rgyal rtag tu lhun gyis grub pa ni/ /'gro ba 'di yis thob par bya ba'i phyir/ /khyad 'phags gnas la bdag gis gnas par bgyi/ /lan gsum/ sa ma ya āḥ rang gi snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba lta bu'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas par gyur/ ces brjod/ snying khar rdo rje reg cing oṃ sū ra ti sa ma ya satwaṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā sū kham̐/ zhes brjod cing brtan par bsam/ sdom pa bzung ba ni/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yis/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang lan drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/

/byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /lan gsum/ rang gi gnas gsum du bh+ri ta sogs rigs gsum spyi'i sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ yang rdo rje khu tshur steng 'og tu re mos kyis kha sbyar te/ snying kha lkog ma kha phyogs dang / /dpral ba mdzod spu rna ba gnyis/ /mgo bo gtsug phud dpung ba gnyis/ /sna dang sked pa pus mo bol/ /long bu sna yi rtse mo dang / /mig gnyis dang ni gsang ba'i gnas/ /zhes pa ltar gnas nyi shu rtsa gnyis su gtugs pa'i tshul bya zhing mos pa byas la/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha dz+nyā na sa mā ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpar gyur par bsam la/ badz+ra sa twa ham̐/ zhes nga rgyal bzung ste byin gyis rlobs pa'o/ /smon lam gdab pa ni thal mo sbyar la/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di sems can thams cad dang thun mong byas nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig ces brjod/ zab mo'i chos bshad pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni re 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gi sems can mnyam med don/ /bla med byed par nus pa yin/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /sngon chad sdig pa byas pa gang /

/dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /skyobs pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang gi spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yis sbyong bar 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa/ /bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen du/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po phyir 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams der ni dong pas na/ /rang byung bskal pa chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes brjod cing spro ba bskyed de chos bshad pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra sa twa kro dha/ a na larka ma hā badz+ra kro dha/ dra ba dra ba/ bi dra ba bi dra ba/ sarba a pa ya/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ ha ra ha ra/ pra nan hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes brjod cing gsum rgyal gyi sngags rang gi gnas gsum du gtugs te/ bsrung ba bya ba rnams ni slob ma sta gon no/ /de nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i phyir maṇ+ḍal phul la/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung zhig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun tshogs ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du sogs gong sta gon dang 'dra/ ras dmar pos gdong bcings par bsam la/ āḥkham̐ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes dang / yang ā kham̐ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog phreng ba gnang bar bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas rang rdo rje sems par bsgom/ rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis mnyam pas me tog bzung nas/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/

zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs par bsam/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thugs kha nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin hūm̐ gi rnam par byon pas rang gi lus la char babs pa bzhin sib sib thim pas snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ye shes hūm̐ gi rnam pas zhugs par bsam la/ rdo rje bsdams pa rang gi snying khar bzhag cing / oṃ badz+ra pra bhe sha ya hūm̐/ zhes bcu nas brgya'i bar brjod pas ye shes dbab/ de nas rang gi spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/ oṃ a sa me/ tri sa me ma hā sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas dam la bzhag cing brtan par bsam/ sangs rgyas dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ /bdag la thugs brtser dgongs nas ni/ /'gro la phan phyir gtso chen gyis/ /dman par dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra pra ti gṛh+ṇa hūm̐/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor la me tog phul bar bsams/ oṃ pra tits+tsha badz+ra sa mā ya satwam̐/ zhes dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bla ma rang gi mgor me tog gnang bar bsam/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya snying khar gtugs te oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hri da ya mi prā be sha ḍi ḍa tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brjod pas kun rig snying khar bzhugs shing brtan par bsam/ de nas rnam rgyal bum chu cung zad 'thung zhing / 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /ci ste dam tshig 'das na ni/ /de ma thag tu bral te gshegs/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas kyang / /bdun brgyud rigs rnams rlag par byed/ /de bas rtag tu bu khyod kyis/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i dam tshig dang / /sdom pa dang ni bla ma'i bka'/ /shin tu mos pas bsrung bar bya/ /zhes pas dam tshig bsgrag cing / khyod kyis srog chags bsad mi bya/ /ma byin pa yang blang mi bya/ /brdzun dang 'dod la spyod pa rnams/

/dngos grub 'dod pas bya ba min/ /chang ni btung bar mi bya zhing / /sha la sogs pa bza' mi bya/ /sems can gnod pa'i sbyor ba ni/ /nam yang bya ba ma yin no/ /dkon mchog gsum ni yongs mi spang / /dus kun tu ni byang chub sems/ /snying po sngags dang phyag rgya dang / /lha dang bla ma de bzhin no/ /sdig pa la sogs pa gang yin pa/ /bla ma'i bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /lha la phul ba'i snyigs ma dang / /de yi grib la 'gom mi bya/ /phyag rgya'i gzugs la de bzhin no/ /sngags dang lha la smad mi bya/ /gdon gyi las sogs bya ba min/ /mu stegs can la smad mi bya/ /mdor na yi gnyis the tshom som nyi mi bya ste/ bdag gi de nyid dang ni sngags sogs de bzhin no/ /zhes brjod pas dam tshig bsgrags shing sdom pa sbyin pa ste/ 'jug pa'i cho ga'o/ /dbang bskur ba la slob ma'i dbang bskur gyi don du/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab sogs nas ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid ni/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur sogs/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang skur zhu ba'i yon du sogs gong bzhin dang / byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyabs pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /lan gsum gyis kha bkang / de nas kun rig rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs sngags kyi rnam pa gser btso ma'i mdog can dpag tu med pa byung ste/ rang rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i spyi bo nas thim par bsam la/ rtsa rig dang / oṃ sarba bid sarba a wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ oṃ sarba bid phaṭ/ oṃ sarba bid a/ oṃ sarba bid tra tha/ oṃ sarba bid oṃ/ oṃ sarba bid swa/ oṃ sarba bid a/ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ oṃ sarba bid tra tha/ oṃ sha oṃ bha/ zhes brjod cing rang gi spyi bor rdo rje bzung / nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang /

dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos rang la dbang bskur bar bsam la/ rnam rgyal bum pa rang gi spyi bo/ dpral ba/ rna ltag g.yas/ ltag pa/ rna ltag g.yon rnams su sngags dang bstun nas bzhag cing / oṃ bud+dha kā la sha a bh-i ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kā la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na kā la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ oṃ pad+ma kā la sha a bh-i ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ karmā kā la sha a bhi ṣits+tsha a/ bum chu nas cung zad tsam btung ba ste chu'i dbang ngo / /de nas rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan mgo la bcings shing / oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes rigs lnga'i phyag rgya rang gi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar gtugs shing / slar gong bzhin bud+dha sogs brjod cing phyag rgya'i dbang bskur/ cod pan gyi dbang la gnyis yod pa'i dang po rin po che'i phreng ba/ dbu rgyan gyi rtsa chings su gnang dbang bskur bar mos la/ oṃ rat+na ma la a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐ tram̐ tram̐ tram̐ tram̐/ zhes rtsa chings bcings/ gnyis pa kha dog lnga pa'i dar dpyangs dbu rgyan gyi steng du gon la/ oṃ badz+ra pa tra laṃ pa a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ zhes brjod de dbu rgyan rtsa chings dar dpyangs gsum ni cod pan gyi dbang ngo / /phyag rgya'i dbang gi don du rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan lnga dang / phyag mtshan lngas yu ba byas pa'i dril bu gnang bar bsam la/ oṃ bud+dha mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ oṃ pad+ma mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karmā mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes brjod do/ /rdo rje dang dril bu'i dbang ngo / /ming gi dbang bskur ba'i phyir rdo dril mnyam du lag pa g.yas pas spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar dkrol zhing / rigs lnga'i ming btags par bsam la/ oṃ bud+dha na ma a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

oṃ rat+na na ma a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ oṃ pad+ma na ma a ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma na ma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥzhes brjod cing ming gi dbang bskur te ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin rig pa'i dbang lnga'o/ /de dag brtan pa'i phyir/ phrin las kyi dbang bskur ni/ rdo dril lag pa g.yon gyi mthil du bzhag oṃ badz+ra karmā a bhi ṣiñtsa zhes brjod de rdo rje brtul zhugs so/ /gnyis pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ rdo dril dang bcas bzhin pas 'khor lo'i phyag rgya rang gi snying khar gtugs la/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ bh+rum̐/ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis rang nyid seng ges btegs pa'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rnam snang rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur par bsam la/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pa ni/ thog mar gong bzhin rdo rje dril bu mnyam du lag pa g.yas kyis rang gi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su dkrol la/ oṃ bud+dha tsakra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ oṃ oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na tsakra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ traṃ traṃ/ oṃ pad+ma tsakra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī hrī hrī/ oṃ karmā tsakra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa a a aḥ yang rigs lnga spyi'i phyag chen bcas la/ oṃ bud+dha tsakra sogs sngags lnga po gong bzhin brjod/ rang nyid rigs lnga spro ba po rnam snang rdor sems su gsal ba ni phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig de nas rdo rje/ chos 'byung / pad+ma/ spyan/ ut+pal te yum lnga'i phyag mtshan rang gi spyi bor gnang bar bsam la/ lag pa g.yon gyis dril bu brkyangs pa gnas lngar dkrol la/ oṃ bud+dha dha ra ṇa a bh-i ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dha ra na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na dha ra na a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ oṃ pad+ma dha ra na a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karmā dha ra na a bh-i ṣiñtsā āḥ zhes brjod pa gsung gi dam tshig go

/de nas rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan rang gi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas sngar gtugs par bsam la lag g.yas kyis rdo rje gnas lngar gsor te/ oṃ bud+dha gu h+ya a bh-i ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ oṃ pad+ma gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karmā gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes brjod pas rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig go /de nas rdo rje dril bu snying khar bsnol la/ oṃ prañdza ut+pa yo ga sa ma ya a bh-i ṣiñtsa hūm̐ a/ zhes brjod/ de ring phyin chad bu khyod kyi/ /phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis/ /nga yis ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin/ /khyod kyis de ltar bya dgos so/ /zhes brjod de/ mtha' rten du rin chen sna bdun te rgyal srid sna bdun gyi gzugs lag tu gnang ba'i mos pa byas la/ phyag rgya bcas shing / oṃ tsakra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ oṃ wasti rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ oṃ ma hā sta rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ oṃ hasti rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ oṃ tu raṅga a shwa rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ oṃ khad+ga rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ zhes brjod la bka'i dbang ngo / /de nas dam tshig bsrung ba ni/ tshe 'di'i bde ba ma lus dang / /'jig rten phyi ma'i bde mchog dang / /sangs rgyas nyid kyang thob 'gyur na/ /lha yi bde ba smos ci dgos/ /sangs rgyas kun dang bla ma mnyam/ /rdo rje slob dpon brnyas na ni/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal thob 'gyur bas/ /slob dpon nyid la brnyas mi bya/ /rdo rje spun dang sring mo dang / /rdo rje ma rnams nyid la ni/ /rnal 'byor can gyis brnyas mi bya/ /rtag tu mkhon dang bcug mi bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed la/ /bzod pa bsgom pa mi bya 'o/ /bla ma dmod btsun ma rung dang / /dam tshig las ni 'da' ba dang / /de sogs byed pa tshar bcad nas/ /'grub 'gyur zhes ni kun rig gsungs/ /sems can kun la shas cher chags/

/bsgrub na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes brjod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ /lan gsum brjod la khas blangs/ de nas maṇ+ḍal bdun ma phul la/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dbang yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu dbul bar bgyi'o/ /sogs brjod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ de dag gis ni bdag 'jug blangs pa'o/ /de nas bdag bsgrub cing brtan byed kyi bzlas pa bya ba ni dbang rdzogs 'phral lha so so la dmigs nas rang sngags tshar re dang phyi'i sems dpa' bcu drug dang / nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ khro bo/ khor yug gi lha yongs rdzogs rnams la gzungs ring lan re re ste tshar lnga brjod pa'i rjes su/ de nas rdo rje 'dzin ma'i sngags dang phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor du zhugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dha ra zhes pas sbyong rgyal dang bdag tha mi dad du bsam/ de bzhin du rat+na dha ras rgyal mchog pad+ma dha ras shāka thub/ bi shwa dha ras dkyil 'khor gyi me tog cher rgyas dang bdag tha mi dad pa'i nga rgyal bzung / ta thā ga ta sa ma ya ma ti kra ma ta thā ga ta sa ma ya dha ra at+ma ko3haṃ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad spro ba po rnam snang dang bdag tha mi dad cing go sa gcig par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra dha ra sogs nas/ ko3haṃ zhes lan gsum du brjod cing nga rgyal bzung ngo / /de nas rang nyid rdo rje'i rnam pas gtso bo'i thugs ka nas thon te/ sngar gyi gnas su 'dug la dkyil 'khor brtan pa'i ched du lha so so'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad/ rtsa ba'i rig pa ci nus su bzlas la rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad brtan par bzhugs nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyang du gsol/

ces gsol ba btab bo/ /gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba gnyis/ tshe ldan dbang gis rjes su bzung ba dang / tshe 'das sdig pa sbyong bas rjes su bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ slob ma dngos su gyur pa gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar zung du ma gyur pa khrus kyi don du chab btang ste gral la 'khod pa la/ las kyi slob mas me tog bkye bsdu tshar ba dang / slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du khyab bdag rnam snang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang / chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa rnams kyang rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung lugs dri ma med pa nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gdul bya so so'i bsam pa dang / khams dang / bag la nyal dang rjes su mthun par chos kyi rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs kyang / de rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rdo rje theg pa yin zhing / de la rgyud sde gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga dang / drug tu 'dod pa la sogs pa mang du yod pa las/ rgyud sde gsum pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud yin/ de la yang / rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud/ cha mthun gyi rgyud de rnam pa gsum las/ da lan 'dir skabs su babs pa cha mthun gyi rgyud kyi khongs su gtogs pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/ grub chen kun snying gis bkral ba'i rjes su 'brang nas/ rgyud de'i brtag pa dang po'i dngos bstan/ bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba sgrub par byed pa la/ gang gi dbang bskur slob dpon ni/ /sngags dang rgyud dang man ngag shes/

/cho ga'i las la rab tu mkhas/ /snying rjes slob ma rab 'dzin pa/ /dbang bskur ba yi slob dpon mchog /ces gsungs pa ltar gyi mtshan nyid ci rigs dang ldan pa zhig dgos shing / gang la dbang bskur ba'i slob ma yang / dad dang snying rje sems rab dul/ /rnam rtog nyung zhing blo dang ldan/ /sngags kyi lam mchog don gnyer ba/ /mthun zhing grangs dang ldan par bzung / /zhes pa ltar gyi mtshan nyid ci rigs dang ldan pa nyi shu rtsa lnga man chad nges par dgos pa yin/ ji ltar bskur ba'i cho ga la slob dpon gyi bya ba dang / slob ma'i bya ba gnyis kyi dang po slob dpon gyi bya ba ni/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa/ bum pa sgrub pa/ mdun bskyed bsgrub cing mchod pa/ 'jig rten pa la gtor ma btang ba/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ bdag sgrub cing bzlas pa bya ba rnams sngon du legs par song nas/ da khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa/ gnyis pa slob ma'i bya ba la/ slob ma sta gon 'jug pa dang bcas pa dang / dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po slob ma sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /sogs lan gsum/ sta gon 'jug pa dang bcas rnams la/ chos bcu bdun yod pa las/ thog mar rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba can gyi sems bskyed pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor lha sum cu rtsa bdun mgron thabs kyi lha dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams 'khod nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

dbang med bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa dang / /sogs lan gsum/ de ltar rgyud dag par byas nas/ nang gi sems bskyed pa'i don du slob dpon gyis sa ma ya a/ zhes brjod pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba lta bu'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba bcas pa re gsal lam te byung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid slob dpon gyis snying kar rdo rje bzhag pa'i sgo nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod cing slob ma'i snying kar rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ sū ra te sogs brjod/ de nas dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin pa la rigs lnga spyi dang so so'i dam tshig gnyis su 'dus pa las/ spyi'i dam tshig ni/ gzhan don rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya'o snyam pa'i smon pa dang / de'i ched du nyes spyod thams cad sdom pa dang / dge ba chos bsdud/ sems can don byed rnams bsgrub par bya snyam pa rnams 'jug pa sems bskyed pa rnams yin zhing / so so'i dam tshig ni/ rnam snang gi dam tshig tu dkon mchog gsum mi 'bral bar 'dzin pa/ mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig tu rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid/ bla ma dang bzhi 'dzin pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dam tshig tu chos kyi sbyin pa/ zang zing gi sbyin pa/ mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa/ byams pa'i sbyin pa ste nyin lan gsum/ mtshan lan gsum du gtong ba/ 'od dpag med kyi dam tshig tu phyi bya spyod/ gsang ba rnal 'byor rgyud/ nyan thos rang rgyal/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa rnams 'dzin pa/ don yod grub pa'i dam tshig tu gong gi dam tshig sdom pa rnams la nan tan gyi sgo nas bla ma dang dkon mchog la mchod pa'i las ci nus su bya ba rnams yin/ de ltar shes par byas nas rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gis bsdus pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /sogs lan gsum/ de ltar sems bskyed nas sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab pa'i don du/ slob dpon gyi rigs gsum spyi'i sngags rgyas khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du gtugs pa la brten nas lus ngag yid gsum de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod cing slob dpon gyi thal mo slob ma'i dpral bar reg la/ oṃ bh+ri ta sogs dang / thal mo snyim par sbyar ba mgrin par bzhag la/ oṃ traṭa traṭa sogs dang / rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis mthe bong che chung rnams brkyangs te rtse sbyar ba snying khar bzhag oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha sogs brjod/ de ltar sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs nas/ snying kha lkog ma kha phyogs dang / /dpral ba mdzod spu rna ba gnyis/ /mgo bo gtsug phud dpung pa gnyis/ /sna dang sked pa pus mo bol/ /long bu sna yi rtse mo dang / /mig gnyis dang ni gsang ba'i gnas/ /zhes pa ltar gyi dpral ba mdzod spu gcig tu byas pa'i gnas nyi shu rtsa gnyis su slob dpon gyis khu tshur steng 'og tu re mos kyis kha sbyar te gnas de dag tu reg cing / oṃ badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha dz+nyā na sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod pa la brten nas snying kha la sogs pa'i gnas de dang de dag rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas khyed rang rnams rdo rje sems dpar gyur pa'i mos pa mdzad nas nga rgyal 'dzin pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ badz+ra satwa ham̐/ zhes brjod pa la brten nas rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa ste de rnams ni byin gyis rlabs pa yin/ smon lam gdab pa ni/ rang gi 'das ma 'ongs da ltar dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams kyi mthu dang nus pa la brten nas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig snyam pas thal mo sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di sogs brjod/ de ltar brjod nas zab mo'i chos bshad pa'i sgo nas spro ba bskyed pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /sogs brjod/ de'i don 'di yin te/ 'jig rten na gang dkon na u dum wa ra'i me tog dkon/ dkon pa ltar sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byon pa dkon/ de las kyang chos gsung ba dkon/ chos kyi nang nas kyang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gsung ba dkon/ de ltar dkon pa ltar phan yon chen po dang ldan pa yin te/ dkyil 'khor chen po mthong ba tsam gyi mod la bskal pa bye ba dpag tu med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad 'dag par 'gyur na dbang blangs te dam tshig dang sdom pa la nan tan du byas nas lam bsgom pa la brtson pa bskyed na 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar pa lta ci smos/ de bas na khyed rang rnams kyis rnyed pa'i mchog legs par rnyed cing rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyis yongs su bzung ste/ de'i rigs su skyes bzhin par gyur pas na theg pa chen po'i lam mchog 'di la brten la sangs rgyas kyi gong 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur bas blo 'di las gzhan du mi 'gyur bar dga' ba dang spro ba rgya chen po bsgom par mdzod cig de ltar spro ba bskyed nas bsrung ba bya ba'i slad du slob dpon gyis 'jig rten gsum gyi sngags rgya khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du gtugs shing oṃ badz+ra satwa kro dha sogs lan gsum brjod/ de ltar gnas gsum du gtugs pa la brten nas khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dang / dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar bar chad bsrung ba rnams kyis slob ma sta gon gyi cho ga song nas/ 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas khyed rang rnams sngon chad bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'am/

zhugs kyang bskyar nas 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du dar yug dmar po res gdong bcing ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes pas gdong bcings nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i de'i tshe phyag stong par mjal du mi rung bas na u dum wa ra la sogs pa'i me tog gi phreng ba re phyag rten gyi slad du sbyin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ de ltar byin te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ zhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams rdo rje sems dpar lam ste gyur par mos nas khyed rang rnams kyi lag pa rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis mnyam du brkyangs pa rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgyas me tog bzung nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la dbu dud tsam dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i nang du 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas ye shes dbab pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la gus 'dud drag po dung ba zhig byas pas/ gtso bo la sogs pa'i lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin hūm̐ gi rnam pa tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la char chen po babs pa bzhin sib sib thim pa la brten nas khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes yi ge hūm̐ gi rnam par zhugs pa la brten nas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar reg ste/ oṃ badz+ra pra bhe sha ya hūm̐/ zhes mang du brjod/ ye shes phab pa'i nyams myong rgyud la skyes pa de spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag pa'i sgo nas brtan par byas shing nyams myong skyes pa de su la yang ma smra zhig

ces dam la bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ a sa me tri sa me ma hā sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod de brtan par bya ba dang / dam la bzhag pa yin/ zhes thams cad kyi spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag de nas khyed rang rnams gral rim bzhin bzhengs te 'di na bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ de yang gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir du gtso bo dang 'khor gyi rnam pa can du bstan pa tsam ma gtogs/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes gcig nyid las grub pa yin pas bzang ngan nam/ mchog dman gyi rnam pa cung zad tsam yang med mod/ 'on kyang rang gi las 'brel bzhag pa'i lha zhig la 'bab par shog snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ /bdag la thugs brtser dgongs nas ni/ /'gro la phan phyir gtso chen gyis/ /dman par dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra pra ti gṛh+ṇa hūm̐/ zhes gtso bo la 'bul ba'i stangs ka re mdzod/ slob dpon gyis me tog gi phreng ba de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ pra tits+tsha badz+ra sa ma ya satwam̐/ de nas slob dpon gyis oṃ badz+ra ha s+ya uta gha ṭa ya hūm̐/ zhes gdong ras dkrol te/ de ltar mi shes pa'i mig gi rab rib dag nas ye shes kyi mig thob ste thar pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du gzigs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hoḥ zhes pas dkyil 'khor lta bar bskul te/ gang la lta ba'i dkyil 'khor ni kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs yin te/ de yang slob dpon gyis ngag tu brjod pa bzhin/ khyed rang rnams ma yengs par gsan te gsal lam te gzigs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de la 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa/

gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng rin po che'i pha gus bskor ba la steng nas dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang zhing / 'da' yab dang pu shus mdzes par byas pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang / g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang / snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan dang / 'phan la sogs pa'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas 'khod pa/ de'i phyi rol khyams kha dog sna tshogs pa'i phyi rol tu 'jig rten pa'i khor yug sngon po/ phyi rol gyi rdo rje'i ra ba dang 'od zer phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'o/ /de'i nang du rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ chos kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu drug pa/ lte ba le tshe dgu pa'i phyogs bzhi nas ka ba gnyis gnyis te brgyad kyis btegs pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang / de'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje dang / rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ khang bzang gnyis kyi nang gi gzhi thams cad shar sngo/ lhor ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus kyi re mig dkar po'i dbus su seng ge'i khri/ shar du glang po che'i khri/ lhor rta'i khri/ nub tu rma bya'i khri/ byang du mkha' ldings rnams kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng dang / lha thams cad kyi gnas su pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ phyi sgo khro bo rnams la nyi ma'i gdan/ 'jig rten pa'i khor yug la srog chags la sogs pa so so'i gdan rnams yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni rten gzhal yas khang pa yin la/

brten pa lha ni dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad/ shar du sbyong ba'i rgyal po/ lhor rgyal mchog rin chen/ nub tu shākya ri dbang / byang du me tog cher rgyas te rigs lnga/ shar lhor spyan ma/ lho nub tu mā ma ki nub byang du gos dkar mo/ byang shar du sgrol ma ste yum bzhi dang / 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs la sogs pa rtsibs bcu drug tu rdo rje sems pa la sogs pa'i sems dpa' bcu drug nang gi grwa bzhir sgeg mo la sogs pa'i nang gi lha mo bzhi/ phyi'i grwa bzhir bdug spos ma la sogs pa'i phyi'i lha mo bzhi/ nang gi sgo bzhir lcags kyu ma la sogs pa'i nang gi sgo ma bzhi ste rtsa ba'i lha sum cu rtsa bdun dang / gzhal yas khang phyi ma'i lha snam dang po la phyogs bzhir byams pa la sogs byang chub sems dpa' bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug de'i phyi rol gyi lha snam gyi phyogs bzhir 'phags pa dga' bo la sogs pa'i nyan thos bcu drug snam bu de nyid kyi mtshams bzhi dang phyogs bzhi'i g.yas g.yon gnyis te gnas bcu gnyis su gdung ba sel ba la sogs pa'i rang rgyal bcu gnyis/ sgo phyi ma bzhi'i dbus dang g.yas g.yon/ rgyab rnams su khro bo bzhi/ pho nya bzhi/ mngags pa bzhi/ bran bzhi ste sgo ba bcu drug dang / phyi'i khor yug gi gdan rnams la tshangs pa la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong bcu/ lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ gza' chen brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ rgyal chen bzhi/ 'jigs byed dgu gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun bcu rtsa lnga/ gnod sbyin/ srin po/ bud med/ phra men ma/ rdo rje gnod sbyin ma'i tshogs rnams dang / gzhan yang ri'i lha/ shing gi lha/ grong gi lha/ 'byung ba bzhi'i lha la sogs pa 'jig rten du rnams kyang rang rang gi rgyan cha lugs dang ldan zhing so so'i g.yog 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa ste mdor na bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum lta bur mthong ba yin snyam du dga' spro dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rang gi me tog phog pa'i lha yin snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/

de nas dam tshig 'dzin don du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes brjod pas lha thams cad kyi dam tshig lus la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid brtan pa'i don du slob dpon gyi rdo rje'i phyag rgya khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar gtugs pas kun rig snying la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod cing phyag rgyas reg yang slob dpon gyi rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgyas slob ma'i snying khar gtugs te oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hrī da ya me pra be sha ya dri ḍho tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭ/ de nas bum chu sbyin te/ dam tshig bsgrags pa'i don du mna' chu blud pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /zhes pa nas/ bdag gi de nyid dang ni sngags sogs de bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod cing bum chu blud tshar ba dang / de'i don ni 'di yin te/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /zhes pa nas shin tu mos pas bsrung bar bya/ /zhes dam tshig bsgrags te/ khyod kyis srog chags gsod mi bya/ /zhes pa nas/ bdag gi de nyid dang ni sngags sogs de bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis sdom pa sbyin pa yin te/ de'i don srog gcod pa dang / ma byin pa len pa/ brdzun du smra ba/ 'dod pas log par g.yem pa ste rtsa ba bzhi chang dang lnga ni dbang thob phyin chad khyim pas kyang bsrung dgos na/ rab tu byung bas lta ci smos te/ de rnams dam tshig gi gtso bo lta bu yin pas srog dang bsdos nas bsrung dgos so/ /de'i steng du bsad sha za ba la sogs pa sems can la gnod par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i bsam pa thams cad spangs nas dkon mchog rnam pa gsum dang / dus rtag tu byang chub kyi sems dang / sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / lha dang bla ma rnams nam yang spang bar mi bya zhing / mi dge ba bcu la sogs pa'i sdig pa'i las thams cad bla ma'i bka' bzhin las mi 'da' ba dang / lha la phul ba'i mchod pa'i ro ma snyigs ma dang /

sku gzugs kyi grib ma/ phyag mtshan gyi gzugs brnyan rnams la'ang 'gom par mi bya zhing / sngags dang lha la mi smad pa dang / gzhan la phan pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang mi ldan par gdon bgegs bskrad pa dang gzir ba la sogs pa'i bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du bya'o/ /de rnams kyis dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos song nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal bdun ma phul la/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid ni rdo rje slob ma'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du sogs gong bzhin dang / de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas sogs gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas thog mar sngags kyis dbang bskur ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun bskyed kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs kyi sngags kyi rnam pa'i yig 'bru gser btso ma lta bu'i mdog can dpag tu med pa byung ste khyed rang rnams rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i spyi bo nas zhugs pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib las ngan thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de nyid brtan pa'i phyir du spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ oṃ na mo sogs rtsa rig dang / oṃ sarba bid ces pa nas oṃ bha zhes pa'i bar brjod pas sngags kyi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas bum pa'i dbang bskur ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdun gyi nam mkhar sprul te/ de rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas 'og nas 'byung ba'i dbang rnams rim pa bzhin bskur ba'i mos pa bya dgos pa la thog mar rigs lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas khyed rang rnams rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar bzhag ste dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/

oṃ bud+dha ka la sha sogs lnga brjod/ bum chu sbyin/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rigs lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi dbu rgyan spyi bor bcings te/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi sogs lnga brjod cing byin la/ de nyid brtan pa'i don du phyag rgya lngas kyang dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ ces dang / oṃ bud+dha ka la sogs gong bzhin bskyar nas brjod pa dang bstun/ slob ma'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar rigs lnga'i phyag rgya bca' ba thams cad la tshar ba dang / phyag rgya lngas kyang dbang bskur bas rigs lnga'i sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de ltar phyag rgyas dbang bskur nas cod pan gyi dbang la yang gnyis yod pa'i dang po rin po'i che'i phreng ba dbu rgyan gyi rtsa chings su byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ rat+na ma la a bh-i ṣiñtsa tram̐ tram̐ tram̐ tram̐ tram̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas gzhan don byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de nas kha dog lnga pa'i dar dpyangs slob ma'i dbu rgyan gyi steng du bskon la oṃ badz+ra pa tra laṃ pa a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas gzhan don byed pa la mthu dang ldan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de gsum ni cod pan gyi dbang ngo / /de nas phyag rgya'i dbang gi don du tsa ka li la rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan dang / phyag mtshan lngas yu ba byas pa'i dril bu lag tu byin te/ oṃ bud+dha mu dra sogs brjod cing lag pa g.yas g.yon du sbyin tshar ba dang / zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur bas rigs lnga dang ye shes lnga'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ni rdo rje dril bu'i dbang ngo / /ming gi dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon dang nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha rnams kyis rigs lnga'i ming btags pa'i mos pa mdzod/

ces brjod cing slob dpon gyis rdo dril lhan cig tu slob ma'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar dkrol zhing / oṃ bud+dha na ma sogs lnga brjod de rdo rje sems dpa' zhes pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas kyi mtshan nges pa can thob par byas pa yin/ de dag ni ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rigs lnga'i dbang ngo / /de dag brtan pa'i phyir/ phrin las kyi dbang gi don du rdo rje dril bu mnyam du slob ma'i lag par reg tsam byin te/ oṃ badz+ra karmā a bh-i ṣiñtsa hūm̐ a/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas phrin las bzhi'i sgo nas gzhan don 'bad med du byed nus pa yin no/ /de ni rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so/ /de rnams kyis rdo rje slob ma'i dbang song nas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du 'khor lo re phyag tu gtad cing dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang / 'khor lo bris pa'i tsa ka li lag tu gtad cing slob ma'i snying khar gtugs pa re byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra a bh-i ṣiñtsa hūm̐ bh+rum̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur ba'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams seng ges btegs pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rnam snang chen po'i rang bzhin rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa re rer gsal lam ste gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas bdag po'i dbang ngam/ sku'i dam tshig gi don du rdo dril lag pa g.yas kyis lhan cig tu slob ma'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar dkrol te/ oṃ bud+dha tsakra sogs lnga brjod/ ces gsungs shing dbang bskur bas khyed rang rnams rigs thams cad kyi bdag por dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas gar bskor dang bcas pa'i phyag chen lnga dpon slob gnyis kas mdzad pa zhu/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas la oṃ bud+dha tsakra sogs gong bzhin lnga brjod/

zhes dbang bskur bas khyed rang rnams rigs lnga spro ba po rnam snang rdo rje sems dpar gyur pa'i mos pa mdzad de phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig go /de nas rdo rje/ chos 'byung / pad+ma/ spyan/ ut+pal te yum lnga'i phyag mtshan bris pa'i tsa ka li slob ma'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar bzhag cing / oṃ bud+dha dha ra la sogs lnga brjod cing / mthar lag pa g.yon du sbyin pas dran pa dang shes rab dang ldan par gyis shig ces gsungs te dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de ni gsung gi dam tshig yin/ de nas rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bris pa'i tsa ka li slob ma'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar gtugs te mthar lag pa g.yas su sbyin la/ oṃ bud+dha gu h+ya sogs lnga brjod/ de ltar na thabs ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa bskyed par gyis shig ces gsungs te thugs kyi dam tshig gi don to/ /rdo rje dang dril bu thugs khar bsnol te/ oṃ prañdzā ut+pa sogs brjod/ de ltar khyed la rdo rje dril bu byin te dbang bskur bas khyod rdo rje slob dpon du gyur pa yin pas thabs shes rab stong pa dang snying rje chen po mi 'bral ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig de nas de ring phyin chad bu khyod kyis/ /sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang / oṃ rat+na tsakra a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ sogs rin chen sna bdun gyi tsa ka li rim pa bzhin sbyin tshar ba dang / de ltar sbyin pa'i gnas skabs su 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid dang / mthar thug kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de nas bka'i dbang bskur ba ni/ de ltar mtha' brten rnams grub nas/ bka' bsgo ba 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ tshe 'di'i bde ba ma lus dang / /sogs brjod nas/ de'i don ni 'di yin te/ dbang thob nas dam tshig la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du byas na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du 'grub pas tshe 'di phyi'i bde skyid tsam la ma ltos dngos grub thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur bas bla ma mnyes par bya dgos so/

/bla ma ma mnyes na sdug bsngal thams cad thob par 'gyur bas bla ma mnyes pa'i sgo nas rdo rje spun sogs rang gi grogs su shes par byas nas brnyas pa dang / mkhon 'dzin mi byed par phan sems dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dam tshig rnams la nan tan du bya dgos so/ /de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zab mo thob pa yin pas de dag ni gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang / de ltar dbang yongs su rdzogs pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal bdun ma rgyas pa phul la/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid ni bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha dad med pa la dbang bskur zab mo thob pa'i gtang rag tu dbul bar bgyi'o sogs brjod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas lus longs spyod thams cad bla ma la 'bul zhing cha shas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod/ de rnams kyis kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya che ba mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ba ste tshe ldan dbang gi rjes su bzung ba song nas/ tshe 'das sdig pa sbyang bas rjes su bzung ba ni/ sngar sbyor ba'i skabs su dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su sbyong stegs shing leb bam/ g.yam pa khru gang pa lta bu ji ltar pa la chu tshon nam/ re kha dkar pos pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris/ de'i lte bar 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa bris te/ ras la sogs pa'i steng du bzhag de'i steng du bri rten gyi gos la sogs pa gang rung la ming byang bris pa'i shog bu smyug ma'am shing lta bu gang yang rung ba la btags pa btsugs shog bu la mi byang ni mdun la pad+ma'i steng du ni bris/

mtha' la 'od zer pa ṭa dang / steng du gdugs bris pa'i yu ba pad+ma la btsugs/ shog bu'i rgyab la 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu tshe las 'das gshin po'i ming gang yin pa bris te/ che ge mo zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang / bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /sdig pa sbyang du gsol/ lam bstan du gsol/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol zhes bri'o/ /sbyang chas zhi bas sbyang ba la gtor ma gsum ni phyag len la bgegs gtor 'dra ba'i 'theb kyu gsum la dkar rgyan brgyab pa gtor teb so sor rtse gyen du bstan nas bzhag pa/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba la ting lo dang chang bu sbrags pa gsum gtor teb kyi srag tu rim pas bzhag drag pos sbyang ba la gu gul sogs dang / sdig pa sbyang ba'i til/ khrus la khrus long / ras sam dar dkar po la dri'i thig le lnga'am sa bon bris pa sku phyis/ bye ma'am yung dkar sogs lnga bzlas pa nam byed dus sngags btab pa sogs gshin don la dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad bshams/ de nas bdag 'jug yan chad thams cad rdzogs pa dang / ming byang sogs yak+ṣas bsangs/ shū n+yā tas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs kyi sbyong stegs pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte ba'i steng du nri las 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu tshe las 'das pa ming gang yin pa de nas brjod de/ che ge mo zhes bya ba phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gson po'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/

ces brjod/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ dang / tshe 'das kyi snying ka'i nri las 'od 'phros pas tshe 'das kyi rnam shes khams gsum gang du gnas pa nas bkug par bsam/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ ngag tu/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas gyi bden pa dang / chos kyi bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang / gsang sngags dang rigs sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi bden pa/ bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa chen pos byin gyis rlabs kyis/ 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu tshe las 'das pa ming 'di zhes bya ba khams gsum rigs drug skye gnas bzhi gang na gnas kyang skad cig nyid la sdig pa sbyong ba'i rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig oṃ ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pa lan gsum/ oṃ shwa dha ne shwa dha ne sarba pā paṃ a pa na ye hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brjod pas bar do'am rigs drug gang na gnas pa nas rnam shes bkug ste rten la thim par bsam mo/ /de nas sdig pa bral ba'i phyir lag pa gnyis rdo rje'i bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis dang tha ma bzhi rtse sprad pa mnye zhing / oṃ sarba bid sarba pā pam̐ bi shwa dha ni hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ sarba bid tra tha/ oṃ badz+ra pa ṇi bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba a pa na ya/ ban+dha ni pra mok+ṣa ya/ sarba a pa na ga ti bh+yaḥ sarba sa twan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya tra tha/ zhes brjod pas sdig pa bral bar bsam la/ badz+ra ban+dha zhes brjod cing rdo rje bsdams pa byas/ yang badz+ra gan+dha tra tha/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje bsdams pa kha phye ste se gol brdab/ sngags gnyis dang phyag rgya gong bzhin lan gsum/ yang rdo rje khu tshur gnyis spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su gtug par bsam zhing / oṃ sarba bita badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha dz+nyā na sa ma ye hūm̐/

tshe 'das kyi rnam par shes pa a dkar po dri ma med pa sbyang rung gi rnam pa can du gyur/ de nas zhi bas bgegs sbyang ba'i phyir/ rten gyi mdun du sbyong stegs ji ltar rigs pa'i steng du gtor theb la sogs pa'i snod gsum dang / ting lo dang chang bu sbrags pa gsum po gtor theb kyi srag rnams su ting lo rnams sbar la bzhag gtor ma gsum chus sbyangs la/ mchod g.yog pas gtor ma gsum re re zhing ming byang gi rten la g.yas su bskor ba'i tshul bya zhing / dpon slob thams cad kyi phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya g.yas phyogs su bskor zhing mthar se gol gtogs la/ byin rlabs mi dgos pas/ oṃ sarba bigh+nan na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇa daṃ ba l+yā di swāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ mchog g.yog pas gtor ma blangs snod cig tu bsags/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba ni/ ting lo dang chang bu rten la mchod g.yog pas gong bzhin bskor zhing gtor ma'i 'khris su bzhag dpon slob rnams kyis rdo rje gsor zhing sum+bha ni zlos pa lan gsum byas la mchod g.yog pas gtor ma dang ting lo sogs phyi rol tu dor/ 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu tshe las 'das pa ming nas brjod che ge mo 'di zhes bya ba gson gyi dus na tshe gnas pa la bar du gcod cing / gshin gyi dus na sdig pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad gtor ma lam brngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la sa phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig ces brjod/ drag po'i sbyang ba ni/ dpon slob thams cad khro bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas rdo rje dril bu dang slob dpon gyis spos thogs te/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros te/ khro bo me ltar 'bar ba la ye shes kyi khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha ra dza sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ

zhes brjod cing gdangs dang bcas pas/ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ces sogs kyis spyan drangs/ ar+gham̐ sogs kyis mchod/ dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /sogs bstod pa rgyas pa tshar gcig 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra sogs sh+lau ka lan gsum brjod/ de nas dpon slob rnams kyis khro bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bden pa zhes pa nas bden pa chen pos byin gyis rlabs kyis/ 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa gang yin pa de dag la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyang ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas des tshim par gyis la zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig gal te mi 'gro ba de dag la dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje ye shes kyi me 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis mgo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes drag tu brjod la/ rten gu gul gyis bdug nas/ yungs kar dang nas bsres pas brab/ rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya zhing / sum+bha ni sogs drag sngags mang du brjod/ sems kyis bgegs thams cad phyi rol tu bros par bsam mo/ /de 'dra ba lan gsum bya/ sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ mchod g.yog pa'i mdun du til/ g.yas su me/ g.yon du chu bzhag til mchod g.yog pas lag mthil gnyis su blugs la/ rten la kha phyogs pas lag pa g.yas kyis g.yas dang / g.yon gyis g.yon du bskor/ gnyis ka gshibs la g.yas g.yon du bskor zhing mthar lag pa bsnol te g.yas kyi me dang / g.yon gyi chu la sngags dang bstun nas dor/

de bzhin gsum byas te g.yas kyi ye shes kyi mes bsregs/ g.yon gyi rgya mtsho'i chus bkrus par bsam la/ dpon slob rnams kyis ngag tu 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba'i tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad snying khar yi ge kam̐ nag po'i rnam par gnas pa sna sgor sdig pa ra can gyi rnam par thon nas mdun gyi til la thim pa de nyid g.yas su ye shes kyi mes bsregs shing / g.yon du rgya mtsho'i chus bkrus par gyur/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmin ku ru swāhā/ zhes sngags lan gsum brjod cing / mchod g.yog pas chu de'i khar me nas cung zad blugs te rgya mtsho chen por dor bar bsam la phyi rol tu dor/ dpon slob rnams kyis tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig ces brjod cing bsam/ de nas gong du bshams pa'i bye ma'am yungs dkar la rtsa rig la sogs pa lha sngags tshar re bzlas la sngags btab cing byang bu la brab cing / de bzhin du/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha ne badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba karmā a wa ra ṇa ni bhasmin ku ru hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bruṃ bi na sha ya a na ra ṇa ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ druṃ bi shwa dha ya a wā ra ṇa na hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la ta ka ta ka ha na ha na a wā ra ṇa ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sruṃ sa ra sa ra pra sa ra sarba a wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hūm̐ ha ra ha ra sarba a wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hūm̐ phaṭ sarba a wa ra ṇā ni bi s+pho ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bh+ri ta bh+ri ta sarba a wa ra ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ traṭa traṭa sarba a wa ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da sarba a wa ra ṇa ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ga te he du na hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ga te he du na hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ka ga te he du na hūm̐ phaṭ/

ces sngags rnams lan gsum brjod cing brab la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya sogs/ 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig ces brjod/ de nas khrus kyi don du mchod g.yog pas sku phyis phrag pa g.yon par bkal/ g.yas kyis rnam rgyal bum chu dang / g.yon gyis me long thogs la/ thog mar bzang khrus bya ba'i phyir me long dkyil 'khor la bstan/ me long nang du dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'char bar byas la/ dpon slob rnams kyis dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas ji ltar bltams sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs brjod/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /sogs sngags bcas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ /sogs sngags bcas brjod cing sna tshogs rol mo bya/ mchod g.yog pas rnam rgyal bum chus sku rnams bkrus par bsam la/ me long steng la khrus chu blug de nas mchod g.yog pas sku phyis phrag pa g.yon nas phab ste/ me long nang du sku sogs gzugs brnyan shar ba de phyis par bsam la/ dpon slob rnams kyis/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyis so/ /oṃ hūm̐ tram̐ hrī a ka ya bi shwa dha ne swāhā/ zhes sku phyis par bsam la phyi tshul bya/ de nas khrus byas pa'i chu de slar rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du blugs la/ byang rten me long nang du gzugs brnyan shar bar byas la bum chus bkru zhing dpon slob rnams kyis dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /gtong pa dri yis legs bgos chus/ /khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /zhes dang / sna tshogs rol mo dang bcas pas rtsa rig tshar gcig brjod/ de bzhin du/ 'di ni tshul khrimsྎ khrims 'chal dri maྎ /tshul khrims dri yisྎ /khrus legs mdzad sogs rtsa rig dang rol mo 'dra/

'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhinྎ /khong khro'i dri maྎ /bzod pa dri yisྎ /khrus legs mdzad sogs rtsa rigs dang rol mo 'dra/ /'di ni brtson 'grusྎ /le lo'i dri maྎ /brtson 'grus dri yisྎ /khrus legs mdzad sogs rtsa rigs dang rol mo 'dra/ 'di ni bsam gtanྎ /rnam g.yengྎ /bsam gtan dri yisྎ /khrus legs mdzad sogs rtsa rig dang rol mo 'dra/ /'di ni shes rabྎ /shes 'chalྎ /shes rab dri yisྎ /khrus legs mdzadྎ /sogs rtsa rig dang rol mo sogs 'dra/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas/ /bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni/ /gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing / /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang rtsa rig sna tshogs rol mo 'dra/ dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas/ /dri ma rnam drug sbyong mdzad pa/ /rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa'i/ /khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'/ /zhes dang rtsa rig dri ma rnam drug dag pa yis/ /yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du/ /dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi 'o/ /zhes brjod cing / tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pa re re'i mjug tu bum chu blugs pa'i mthar/ 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu tshe las 'das pa che ge mos gtso byas sems can thams cad kyis pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi mi mthun phyogs dag nas/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig de nas nyon mongs pa'i dug dang / nyon mongs pa las skyes pa'i 'byung ba'i dug sbyangs shing bkrus par bsam la/ sngar bzhin me long ldan la bum chu blug cing / 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan dug mi mnga'/ /sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo/ /rtsa rig dang rol moྎ /'dod chagsྎ /'di dag 'jig rtenྎ /bcom ldan dam chosྎ /dam chos bden pasྎ /rtsa rig rol moྎ /'dod chagsྎ /'di dagྎ /'phags pa'i dge 'dunྎ

/dge 'dun bden pasྎ /rtsa rig dang rol moྎ /dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs gyis 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba'i nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad bcom nas lus ngag yid gsum dge ba gsum dang ldan par gyur cig yang me long ldan la bum chu blug cing / sa 'di dug gi pha yin te/ /sa 'di dug gi ma yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis/ /dug gsum sa yi nang du song / /rtsa rig dang rol mo/ chu ni dug gi pha yin te/ /sogs 'don pa bsgyur la/ me 'diྎ /rlung 'di sogs/ dug gsum rlung gi nang du song / /rtsa rig rol mo 'dra/ 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu tshe las 'das pa che ge mos gtso byas pa'i sems can gyi 'byung ba bzhi la brten pa'i nyon mongs pa rnam rtog rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad 'byung ba bzhi'i chos nyid kyi ngang du thim nas/ sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad bral bar gyur cig ces brjod/ de nas mchod g.yog pas khrus long bzhag la/ rnam rgyal bum pa g.yon pas bzung / g.yas pa ku sha'i rtsa la tshigs bcad re re bstun rten la 'thor tshul bya/ dpon slob kyis dril gsil gdangs dang bcas tshigs bcad re re'i mjug tu dril gsil dang / rten la me tog gtor zhing / gang la ser sna rnam chags pa/ /rnam bcom dri ma med mdzad cing / /thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams/ /thar ba'i lam du 'jug mdzad cing / /chos rnams thams cad ston pa ste/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /gang la bde ba mnga' mdzad des/ /khyed laྎ /skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yis/ /thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des/

/khyed la bdeྎ /gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi/ /sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing / /gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des/ /khyed laྎ /gang zhig chos kun mngon sum 'gyur/ /gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' la/ /gsum gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des/ /khyed laྎ /dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa/ /phun sum tshogs don gang 'byor zhing / /don grub tshogs kyang 'grub pa des/ /khyed laྎ /gang zhig skyes pa'i sa rnams ni/ /nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yo zhing / /sems can thams cad rab dga' des/ /khyed laྎ /byang chub snying por gshegs pa na/ /sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing / /bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzadྎ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs shing / /thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des/ /khyed laྎ /yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed/ /thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing / /tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des/ /khyed laྎ /sangs rgyas khyed cag bde legs mdzad/ /brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang / /'byung po kun gyis bde legs ni/ /khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang / /lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis/ /khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa/ /don de de ring grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam du bde legs shog /phyir 'ongs dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing / /khyed cag kun tu bde legs 'gyur/ /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /ces dril gsil dang / nas dang bum chu gtor/ de nas tshe las 'das pa che ge mos gtso byas pa'i skye dgu thams cad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal zhing shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod/ de nas bu la sogs pa'i nye du yod na ming byang lag pa gnyis kyi bar du bzung nas phyag byed du gzhug

med na mchod g.yog pas byas kyang btub/ dpon slob rnams kyis thal mo sbyar la gdangs dang bcas pas/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon/ /'gro ba skyobs pa'i don brtson pa/ /stobs chen 'jigs pa rnam sel ba/ /bdag ni skyabs su mchi lags so/ /de yi thugs su chud pa'i chos/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel mdzad pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang / /de bzhin tshe 'das skyabs su mchi/ /tshe 'das 'jigs pa cher mthong nas/ /kun tu bzang la tshe 'das 'bul/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la tshe 'das kyi/ /lus 'di bdag gis dbul bar bgyi/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul ba'i/ /spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang / /nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod/ /sdig ldan 'di la skyabs su gsol/ /'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang / /sa yi snying po dag dang ni/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid thams cad la/ /phyag 'tshal snying nas 'o dod 'bod/ /gang zhig mthong nas gshin rje yi/ /pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams/ /skrag nas phyogs bcur 'byer byed pa/ /rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi/ /de yan tshar gcig sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das/ /da ni 'jigs pa cher mthong nas/ /khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyis/ /'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol/ /ces sh+lau ka gcig po tshar gsum brjod la/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang / byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad dang bcas pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /sdig pa sbyang du gsol/ lam bstan du gsol/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes tshe 'das kyis snying thag pa nas 'gyod sems drag pos gsol ba 'debs par bsam mo/ /de nas gshin po la dbang bskur ba'i phyir/ gshin po byang rten la bstim pa de dngos su yod par bsam la/

slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la slob dpon gyi bya ba dang / slob ma'i bya ba gnyis las/ slob dpon gyis maṇ+ḍal bdun ma phul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ dga' che khyod bdag tshar gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas thog mar rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba can gyi sems bskyed pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i kun rig gi lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams 'khod nas sdig pa bshags pa sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dbang med bdag gi mi dge bgyis pa dang / /sogs lan gsum/ de ltar rgyud dag par byas nas nang gi sems bskyed pa'i don du slob dpon gyis sa ma ya a/ zhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa re gsal lam ste byung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid slob dpon gyi snying khar bzhag pa'i sgo nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod cing gshin po'i snying khar bzhag par bsam la/ rdo rje reg pa'i tshul byas la/ su ra te sogs brjod/ de nas dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /sogs lan gsum/ de ltar sems bskyed nas sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs pa ni/ slob dpon gyis khyed rang gi gnas gsum du rigs gsum spyi'i sngags rgyas btugs pa la brten nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/

slob dpon gyi thal mo gshin po'i dpral bar reg par bsam la/ oṃ bh+ri ta sogs dang / de bzhin du mgrin par oṃ traṭa traṭa sogs dang / snying khar oṃ ts+tshin+dha sogs brjod la slob ma dbang bskur bzhin no/ /slar yang slob dpon gyis rdo rje khu tshur re mos kyis steng 'og tu re mos kyis kha sbyar te gshin po'i snying kha la sogs pa gnas nyi shu rtsa gnyis su reg par mos shing / badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sogs brjod pa la brten nas snying kha la sogs pa'i gnas de dang de dag rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas khyed rang rdo rje sems dpar gyur pa'i mos pa mdzad nas nga rgyal 'dzin pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ badz+ra satwa ham̐/ zhes brjod par bsam pa la brten nas nga rgyal 'dzin pa ste/ de rnams byin gyis rlabs pa yin/ smon lam gdab pa'i don du tshe 'das rang gi dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams kyi mthus sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sogs brjod par bsam/ zab mo'i chos bshad pa'i sgo nas spro ba bskyed pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /sogs brjod de/ de'i don ni 'di yin te/ 'jig rten du gang dkon na sangs rgyas 'byon pa dkon/ de las kyang chos gsung ba dkon / chos kyi nang nas kyang rdo rje theg pa gsung ba dkon/ de ltar dkon pa ltar phan yon chen po dang ldan pa yin te/ dkyil 'khor chen po mthong ba tsam gyis sdig sgrib thams cad 'dag par 'gyur na/ dbang blangs te dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom byas na rnyed pa'i mchog legs par rnyed cing / sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur bas dga' spro rgya chen po sgom par gyis shig de ltar spro ba bskyed nas bsrung ba bya ba'i don du slob dpon gyis 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi sngags rgyas khyed kyi gnas gsum du gtugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/

oṃ badz+ra sa twa kro dha sogs lan gsum mdzod/ de ltar gnas gsum du gtugs pa la brten nas khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang / dbang len pa'i bar chad thams cad bsrung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de rnams kyis slob ma sta gon gyi chos song nas/ 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ gong bzhin mchod g.yog pas phul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas khyed rang sngon chad bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar dar yug dmar po res gdong bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ āḥkham̐ wi ra hūm̐/ zhes pas gdong bcings par bsam/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba de'i tshe phyag stong par mjal du mi rung bas u dum wa ra la sogs pa'i me tog gi phreng ba re phyag tu gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ āḥkham̐ wī ra hūm̐/ de ltar byin par bsam la/ khyed rang 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin khyed rdo rje sems dpar lam ste gyur par mos nas rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgyas me tog bzung ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la dbu dud pa dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i nang du 'khod par mos pa dang bcas pas ye shes dbab pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la gus 'dud drag po dung pa zhig byas pas/ lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin hūm̐ gi rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas khyed kyi lus la char chen po babs pa bzhin sib sib thim pa la brten nas khyed kyi snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes hūm̐ gi rnam par zhugs pa la brten nas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyi rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya khyed kyi snying khar reg pa'i mos pa mdzod/

oṃ badz+ra a be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes mang du brjod/ ye shes dbab pa de nyid spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag pa'i sgo nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ a sa me sogs brjod de brtan par bya ba dang dam la bzhag pa yin no/ /de nas khyed rang bzhengs te/ 'di na kun rig gi dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ phyag gi me tog de gtso bo'i dbu thog tu phul bar bsam la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ /sogs sngags dang bcas pa tshar gcig brjod de/ slob dpon gyis me tog gi phreng ba sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas khyed rnams kyi mgo thog tu bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ pra tits+tsha badz+ra sa mā ya satwam̐/ de nas oṃ badz+ra ha s+ya ut+ga dra ya hūm̐/ zhes slob dpon gyis gdong ras dkrol bar mos/ de ltar mi shes pa'i mig gi rab rib dag nas dkyil 'khor mngon sum du gzigs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra pa sh+ya hoḥ zhes pas dkyil 'khor lta bar bskul te/ gang la lta ba'i dkyil 'khor ni kun rig gi dkyil 'khor yin te/ de la 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi la sogs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu drug pa/ lte ba le tshe dgu pa'i phyogs bzhi nas ka ba gnyis gnyis te brgyad kyis btegs pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang / de'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bres shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje dang rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ khang bzang gnyis ka'i nang gi gzhi thams cad shar sngo/ lho ser/

nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus kyi re mig dkar po'i dbus su seng ge'i khri/ shar du glang po che'i khri/ lhor rta'i khri/ nub tu rma bya'i khri/ byang du mkha' lding rnams kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng dang / lha thams cad kyi gnas su pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ phyi sgo khro bo rnams la nyi ma'i gdan/ 'jig rten pa'i khor yug la srog chags la sogs pa so so'i gdan rnams yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni rten gzhal yas khang pa yin la/ brten pa lha ni dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa rigs lnga/ shar lhor spyan ma la sogs pa'i yum bzhi/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcu drug tu rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i sems dpa' bcu drug nang gi grwa bzhir sgeg mo la sogs pa'i nang gi lha mo bzhi/ phyi'i grwa bzhir bdug spos ma la sogs pa'i phyi'i lha mo bzhi/ nang gi sgo bzhir lcags kyu ma la sogs pa nang gi sgo ba bzhi ste rtsa ba'i lha sum cu rtsa bdun dang / gzhal yas khang phyi ma'i lha snam dang po la phyogs bzhir byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug de'i phyi rol gyi lha snam la 'phags pa dga' bo la sogs pa'i nyan thos bcu drug snam bu de nyid kyi mtshams bzhi bzhi sogs gnas bcu gnyis su/ gdung ba sel la sogs pa'i rang rgyal bcu gnyis/ sgo phyi ma bzhi'i dbus dang g.yas g.yon gnyis rgyab rnams su khro bo bzhi/ pho nya bzhi/ mngags pa bzhi/ bran bzhi ste sgo ba bcu drug phyi'i khor yug la phyogs skyong bcu la sogs pa 'jig rten pa rnams so so'i g.yog 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa ste/ mdor na bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa'i rten dang brten pa thams cad mngon sum lta bur mthong ba yin snyam pa'i mos pa mdzad nas/ dam tshig 'dzin pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭ/

zhes brjod pas lha thams cad kyi dam tshig lus la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod cing bsam/ de nyid brtan pa'i don du slob dpon gyi rdo rje'i phyag rgya khyed rnams kyi snying khar gtugs pas kun rig snying la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang slob dpon gyi rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgyas snying khar gtugs te/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hri da ya me pra be sha ya dri ḍha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brjod/ dam tshig bsgrags pa'i slad du chu sbyin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang / rten gyi mdun du bum chu nas snod ci ltar rigs par blugs la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ / 'di yan sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad/ zhes pa nas/ shin tu mos pas bsrung bar bya/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod de/ de'i don/ chu 'di dam tshig gi mna' chu zhes bya ba chu 'di 'thungs phyin chad/ sngar khas blangs pa'i dam tshig rnams ma bsrungs na chu 'di khro chu khol mar gyur nas khyod kyi lus thams cad sreg par byed cing / der ma zad sngar snying khar bzhugs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' de nyid khros te/ khro bo rdo rje me dbal zhes bya bar gyur nas khyod kyi snying dum bur bkas te gshags par byed/ der yang ma zad khro bo des khyod kyi bdun brgyud tshun chad kyi rigs rnams kyang brlag par byed la/ dam tshig bsrung na chu 'di bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur nas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad thob par 'gyur bas na/ bu khyod kyis rgyal bas rnal 'byor rgyud du gsungs pa'i dam tshig rnams la shin tu mos pa dang bcas bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du bya dgos so/ /dam tshig sbyin pa ni/ khyod kyis srog chags sad mi bya/ /zhes pa nas/ bdag gi de nyid dang ni sngags sogs de bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod nas/ de'i don dam tshig sdom pa sbyin pa 'di yin te/ srog gcod pa/

ma byin par len pa/ brdzun du smra ba/ 'dod pas log par g.yem pa ste rtsa ba bzhi/ chang dang lnga ni dbang thob phyin chad khyim pas kyang bsrung dgos na/ rab tu byung bas lta ci smos te/ de rnams dam tshig gi gtso bo lta bu yin pas srog dang bsdos te bsrung dgos/ de'i steng du bsad sha bza' ba la sogs pa sems can la gnod par 'gyur ba'i bsam pa thams cad spangs/ dkon mchog rnam pa gsum dang / dus rtag tu byang chub kyi sems dang / sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / lha dang / bla ma rnams nam yang spang bar mi bya zhing / mi dge ba bcu la sogs pa sdig pa'i las thams cad bla ma'i bka' bzhin las mi 'da' ba dang / lha la phul ba'i mchod pa'i ro ma snyigs ma dang / sku gzugs kyi grib ma/ phyag mtshan gyi gzugs can rnams la'ang 'gom par mi bya/ sngags dang lha la smad par mi bya zhing / gzhan la phan pa'i byang sems dang mi ldan par/ gdon bgegs bskrad pa dang gzir ba la sogs pa'i las mi byed/ grub mtha' blo bsgyur ba yin pas mi stegs pa la'ang mi smad/ mdor na sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i dam tshig la sogs pa chos thams cad yid gnyis the tshom mi bya bar shin tu dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du bya dgos so/ /de rnams kyis dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos song nas/ dngos gzhi dbang skur ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ maṇ+ḍal bdun ma phul la/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas thog mar sngags kyi dbang bskur ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun bskyed kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i lha tshogs rnams las/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs rnams rnam pa gsang sngags yig 'bru'i rnam pa gser btso ma'i mdog can dpag tu med pa byung ste/ khyed rang rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i spyi bo nas zhugs pas/

tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib las ngan thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de nyid brtan pa'i phyir du slob dpon gyis spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ oṃ na moḥ sogs rtsa rig dang / oṃ sarba bita sogs nas/ oṃ bha zhes pa'i bar brjod pas sngags kyi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas bum pa'i chus dbang bskur ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdun gyi nam mkhar sprul te/ de rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas 'og nas 'byung ba'i dbang rnams rim pa bzhin bskur ba'i mos pa bya dgos pa las/ thog mar rigs lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas/ khyed rang rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar bzhag ste dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ bud+dha ka la sha sogs lnga brjod/ bum chu sbyin/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas/ rigs lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi dbu rgyan mgo bor bcings te/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi sogs lnga brjod cing byin la/ de nyid brtan pa'i don du phyag rgya lngas kyang dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang / oṃ bud+dha sogs gong bzhin bskyar nas brjod pa dang bstun/ de'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar rigs lnga'i phyag rgya bca' zhing / phyag rgya lngas kyang dbang bskur bas rigs lnga'i sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de ltar phyag rgyas dbang bskur nas/ cod pan gyi dbang la gnyis yod pa'i dang po rin po che'i phreng ba dbu rgyan gyi rtsa chings su byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ rat+na mā la a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐ trām̐ trām̐ trām̐ trām̐/
