zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur bas gzhan don byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de nas kha dog sna lnga pa'i dar dpyangs slob ma'i dbu rgyan gyi steng du bskon la/ oṃ badz+ra pa ṭa laṃ pa a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur bas gzhan don byed pa la mthu dang ldan par byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de gsum ni cod pan gyi dbang yin/ de nas phyag rgya'i dbang gi don du tsa ka li la rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan dang / phyag mtshan lngas yu ba byas pa'i dril bu bris pa lag tu byin te/ oṃ bud+dha mu dra sogs lnga brjod cing lag pa g.yas g.yon du sbyin tshar ba dang / zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas rigs lnga dang ye shes lnga'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ni rdo rje dril bu'i dbang ngo / /ming gi dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon dang nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha rnams kyis rigs lnga'i ming btags pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod cing slob dpon gyis rdo dril lhan cig tu slob ma'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar dkrol zhing / oṃ bud+dha na maḥsogs lnga brjod de/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs shing ming gi dbang bskur bas ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas kyi mtshan nges pa can thob par byas pa yin no/ /de dag ni ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin ming gi dbang ngo / /de dag brtan pa'i phyir dang / phrin las kyi dbang gi don du rdo rje dril bu mnyam du slob ma'i lag par reg tsam byin te/ oṃ badz+ra karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ aḥzhes gsungs shing dbang bskur bas 'phrin las bzhi'i sgo nas gzhan don 'bad med du byed nus pa yin te/ de ni rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so/ /de rnams kyis rdo rje slob ma'i dbang song nas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du 'khor lo lag tu gtad cing dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/

ces dang / 'khor lo bris pa'i tsa ka li slob ma'i lag tu gtad cing snying khar gtugs pa tsam byas la/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ bh+rum̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur ba'i rkyen gyis khyed rang seng ges btegs pa'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rnam snang chen po'i rang bzhin rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i skur gsal lam ste gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas bdag po'i dbang ngam sku'i dam tshig gi don du rdo dril lag pa g.yas kyis lhan cig tu slob ma'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar dkrol te/ oṃ bud+dha tsakra sogs lnga brjod/ ces gsungs shing dbang bskur bas khyed rang rigs thams cad kyi bdag por dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas gar bskor dang bcas pa'i phyag chen lnga dpon slob gnyis kas mdzad par zhu/ zhes phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ bud+dha tsakra sogs lnga gong bzhin brjod/ ces dbang bskur bas khyed rang rigs lnga spro ba po rnam snang rdor sems su gyur pa'i mos pa mdzad de phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig go /de nas rdo rje/ chos 'byung / pad+ma/ spyan/ ut+pal te yum lnga'i phyag mtshan bris pa'i tsa ka li slob ma'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar bzhag cing / oṃ bud+dha dha ra sogs lnga brjod cing mthar lag pa g.yon du sbyin pas/ dran pa dang / shes bzhin dang ldan par gyis shig ces gsungs te dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de ni gsung gi dam tshig yin/ de nas rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bris pa'i tsa ka li slob ma'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar bzhag cing / oṃ bud+dha gu h+ya sogs brjod la mthar lag pa g.yas par sbyin pas thabs ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa bskyed par gyis shig ces gsungs te thugs kyi dam tshig gi don to/ /slar rdo rje dang dril bu snying khar bsnol te/

oṃ pradz+nyā u pa la sogs brjod cing / de ltar khyod la rdo rje dril bu sbyin te dbang bskur bas/ khyod rdo rje slob dpon du gyur pa yin pas na thabs shes rab stong pa dang snying rje zung du 'jug pa dang mi 'bral ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig de ring phyin chad bu khyod kyi/ /sogs sh+lau ka gcig brjod/ de nas tsakra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ khat+ga rat+na abhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ zhes pa'i bar gyi sngags bdun po brjod cing rgyal srid sna bdun gyi tsa ka li rim pa bzhin sbyin tshar ba dang / de ltar sbyin pa'i gnas skabs su 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid dang / mthar thug kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba yin te/ de nas bka' yi dbang bskur ni/ de ltar mtha' rten rnams grub nas/ bka' bsgo 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ tshe 'di'i bde ba ma lus dang / /sogs brjod nas de'i don 'di yin te/ dbang thob nas dam tshig la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du byas na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du 'grub par 'gyur na/ tshe 'di phyi'i bde skyid tsam la ma ltos/ dngos grub thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur bas/ de'i rtsa ba bla ma mnyes par bya dgos/ bla ma ma mnyes na sdug bsngal thob par 'gyur bas/ bla ma mnyes pa'i thabs la brtson pa'i sgo nas rdo rje spun sogs rang gi grogs su shes par byas nas/ brnyas pa dang mkhon 'dzin mi bya bar phan sems dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dam tshig la nan tan du bya dgos so/ /de rnams kyis kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zab mo thob pa yin pas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyid snyam pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang / dbang rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa 'bul ba sogs gong gson dbang gi skabs bzhin bya'o/

/de ltar dbang bskur bas tshe 'das lha'i rang bzhin du gyur pa la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ sogs rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ dril gsil dang bcas/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod la lam sbyangs bstan bya'o/ /dbang mi bskur na rten de nyid yak+ṣas bsangs/ oṃ swa bha wa nas/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ gcig tu gyur pa las tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po sogs nas/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i sku can du gyur ces pa'i bar brjod la sngar ltar mchod bstod bya/ yul kha cig na zas gtad/ gos l+h+wam gtod pa sogs kyi lugs yod mod/ 'di ni ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon gtan nas med cing / deng sang zas sna la sha chang sogs byed pa zhig 'dug kyang / 'di ni 'khrul pa kho nar mthong la/ gal srid zas sna byed dgos byung na yang dkar gsum kho na dgos par sems/ de nyid 'dod yon sna tshogs pa'i rang bzhin can gyis tshe 'das lhar gsal ba la mchod par bsam zhing / zas sogs yak+ṣas bsang / dz+wa las gzi byin bskyed/ oṃ a ka ro sogs lan gsum brjod de byin rlabs grub 'phral thog mar gshin po lhar bskyed pa la drangs grub pa dang / kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ongs rgyan 'phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos rten gyi lha la bdag 'bul gyis/ /sogs 'dod yon gyi tshig gis mchod la ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i mig gi yul du sogs/ steng ngam gang 'os su me btang la zas sna rnams nas bsur btang ngo / /nub tha ma la byang bu sreg par byed na/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsam zhing me sbar/

'di la rje btsun rin po ches gzhan phan 'od zer du/ gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs kyang / phyag len la/ stong nyid ye shes 'bar ba'i mes/ /tshe 'das sgrib pa'i bud shing dang / /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa/ /ye shes snang bar 'bar gyur cig /ces brjod cing dril bu gsil rtsa rig bzla bzhin pa'i ngang nas bsreg go /byang bu bsregs pa'i thal ba de 'jim pa'am zan gyi khog tu bcug la tsha tsha btab bo/ /de nas lam sbyangs bstan bya ste/ de yang nub gong ma rnams la mchod pa'i rjes dang / nub tha ma la byang bu bsregs pa'i rjes la dril gsil me tog 'thor ba dang bcas/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du/ /dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba/ /dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis/ /rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa/ /tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam/ /mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam/ /bla na med pa'i khyad par lam/ /byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam/ /rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la/ /brten nas sdig pa kun sbyangs nas/ /'phags pa'i lam der 'gro bar shog /oṃ rat+ne rat+te ma hā rat+ne rat+na sam̐ bha we/ rat+na ki rat+ne/ rat+na ma la bi shud+dhe/ sho dha ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ tra thaḥci rigs dang / zhes dang rol mo bya/ pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar/ /srid gsum dri mas ma gos pa'i/ /srid pa'i pad+mo las byung ba'i/ /bde ba can du skye bar shog /oṃ pad+me pad+me pad+ma sam̐ bha we ma hā su kha ba ti gats+tshan+tu swāhā/ ci rigs dang / zhes brjod nas rol mo byas te/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba nub phyogs bde ba can du skyes par bsam/ der skyes pa'i byang sems rnying pa rnams kyis phyis kyi de la ngo mtshar ba'i sgo nas mchod par bsam la/ oṃ ar+gham̐ la sogs pas mchod cing rol mo bya/ des kyang sangs rgyas 'od dpag med 'khor dang bcas pa la skyes kyi tshul du mchod pa ni/ oṃ ar+gham̐ sogs brjod cing rol mo bya/

der skyes ba'i rgyu brtags pas rdo rje slob dpon gyi cho ga'i nus pa yin par shes te/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor pa la ched du gtad pas mchod pa ni/ oṃ ar+gham̐ la sogs brjod cing rol mo bya/ rol mo song ba dang rang dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar la/ e ma ho sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas/ /e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs/ /gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs/ /byang chub spyod pa nyid la bzhag /ces ched du brjod par bsam/ bdag gis kyang slar de la mchod pa ni/ oṃ ar+gham̐ la sogs pas mchod cing rol mo bya/ slar bde ba can du song bar bsam la nub phyogs la me tog dor ro/ /de nas tshe 'das kyi don du bzang spyod la sogs pa'i smon lam rgyas par brjod cing / 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyis rgyas btab ste gshin po rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga'o/ /gsum pa rjes ni/ gshin don yin na lam sbyangs bstan tshar ba'i rjes dang / slob ma dbang bskur yin na dbang chog tshar ba'i rjes dang / sgrub mchod rkyang pa yin na/ mdun bskyed brtan byed kyi bzlas pa tshar ba'i rjes su/ bdag bskyed ltar rang nyid la/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa sogs rigs lnga'i sngags rgyas dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ bh+ri ta sogs rigs gsum spyi'i sngags rgyas byin rlabs brtan par bsgom/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi sngags rgya tshar gsum snying khar bcas la bdag gnas rnal 'byor gsum gyi bar chad bsrung ngo / /de nas mdun bskyed kyi mthar ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa gsar ba bshams pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun bskyed la phul bar bsam zhing / ngag tu/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /mchog tu dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+gham̐ pra tits+tsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ chu dang thang las skyes pa yi/

/me tog dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /badz+ra puṣ+pe/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /bdug spos dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /badz+ra dhuṣ+pe/ mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms byed cing / /phyogs kun gsal ba'i mar me 'di/ /kun mkhyen ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /badz+ra a lo ke lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /dri yi mchod pa 'di dag ni/ /rang byung nyid la 'bul lags kyi/ /kun bzang bde chen bzhes su gsol/ /badz+ra gan+dhe/ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i/ /bza' ba mchog dang yang dag ldan/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i bshos 'di dag /chos dbyings ye shes brnyes la 'bul/ /badz+ra nai wi d+ye/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i don ston zhing / /shes rab mchog gi rjes 'gro rol mo'i sgra/ /bdud kyi 'khor lo gzhom phyir dbul bar bgyi/ /don gyi dbyings la mnga' brnyes 'di bzhes shig /badz+ra shap+ta zhes dang rol mo dbul/ de nas dril bu gsil zhing / chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /ces sogs nas/ rgyud bzhin bdag gis bstod par bgyi'i bar dang / sgeg mo phreng ba de bzhin glu/ /gar ma mchod pa'i lha mo dang / /spos ma me tog mar me ma/ /dri yi lha mo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sgo bzhi'i dbus na legs bzhugs shing / /dad sogs ngo bo rnam dag pa/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril/ /sgo bsrung rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i rjes su/ phyag len ltar gzhal yas khang phyi ma'i lha rnams la'ang / sgo yi khyams na bzhugs pa yi/ /sogs sh+lau ka lngas bstod la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa rnams byang zhing dag pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sogs yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod pa'i rjes su/

ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /legs spyad 'di la nyes byas gang / /gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa/ /de ni mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /gtso bo nus pa ma mchis pas/ /ma 'byor ma rnyed ma tshang ba/ /'dir ni bgyis pa gang bgyis rnams/ /de dag thams cad bzod par mdzod/ /ces sogs kyis cho ga lhag chad kha bskangs shing nongs pa bzod par gsol nas/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs te/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du rgyal ba thams cad mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ ces dang / oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis brtan par byas shing me tog dor ro/ /de nas dril gsil gdangs dang bcas/ ston mchog dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /de bzhin du/ zhi ba chags bralྎ /chos la phyag 'tshalྎ /semsྎ /de dagྎ /tshogs kyi dam paྎ /dge 'dun phyag 'tshalྎ /sems canྎ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /rol chen dang bcas nyin mo bde legs sogs dang / bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las shin tu rgyal bar gyur cig ces brjod nas me tog dor ro/ /slar yang 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i bsngo ba rnam par dag pas rgyas btab la/

ras bris bsdus te bkur bsti dang bcas dben par bzhag mchod rdzas sman pa rnams mgon med pa dang 'phongs pa la sbyin/ gos zung sogs mchod rten dang sangs rgyas kyi sku la phul/ gsang sngags kyi kun tu spyod pa'i las rjes rnams snod dang mi ldan pa'i skyes bu'i mig snang du mi mngon par byas te/ rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ de ltar ngan song thams cad yongs sbyong ba'i/ /kun rig cho ga'i lag len ngo mtshar can/ /sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung rab kyi/ /kha skongs 'di ni bdag gis dad pas sbyar/ /legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba yis/ /bdag cag dpon slob tshe mthar rab phyin zhing / /lus brtas dbang po'i dwangs ma mchog gsal ba'i/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rgyas byed shog /de rgyun bdag gi rigs brgyud gtsang ma yis/ /rgyun du skyong zhing gong nas gong 'phel te/ /sngags 'chang yab sras bstan pa dpal sa skyar/ /srid mthar gnas pa'i yid smon kun 'grub shog /bdag cag dpon slob gdul byar bcas pa rnams/ /phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ /ma gyur 'gro ba kun kyang zhing gi mchog /bde ldan gnas su 'dren pa'i mthu ldan shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i mthus/ /'di phyi'i bsam pa'i don rnams yid bzhin du/ /'bad pa med par lhun gyis grub gyur cig /ces kun rig gi cho ga gzhan phan rnam gnyis kyi gsal byed blo dman dga' ba skyed byed ces bya ba sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung rtsom 'phro can kha bskangs pa don gnyis lhun grub ces bya ba 'di yang / 'jam mgon grub pa'i khyu mchog bsod nams dbang po dang / yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ khyab bdag rnam snang chen po dang dbyer ma mchis pa rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa'i bslu ba med pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/

snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi gsung rtsom ngo mtshar can gyi kha skong bgyid pa la dad pa dang / spro ba dang / mos pa rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis nye bar bskul zhing / lhag par sngon bdag gi bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po dang / yab rje grags pa'i mtshan can gnyis ka'i gsung las/ sngags 'chang chen po'i kun rig cho ga'i gsung rtsom 'phro can 'di nyid la kha skong gi zhabs tog cig cis kyang bya dgos pa yod ces yang yang gsung ba thos shing / de bzhin mdzad pa'i dgongs gtad che bar 'dug kyang / so so nas phyag bzhes gnang grub pa zhig ma byung 'dug par brten/ des na sprul pa'i skyes mchog sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras gsum dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs pa dang / rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i rigs dang chos kyi bu la sogs pa slob ma'i tshogs rnams la phan pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun nas bslangs te/ 'phags pa'i yul na dha raḥzhes grags shing / rgya nag pa me pho byi ba'i lo smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshes la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i bzhi thog bla brang gi yang rtse ngo mtshar 'chi med rdo rje'i pho brang e wam̐ byang chub 'byung ba'i gnas su legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni/ rnam dpyod kyi blo mig gsal zhing yi ge'i 'du byed la phul du phyin pa shab stod pa bkra shis don grub kyis bgyis so/ /'dis bdag cag dpon slob 'di phyi'i bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ka l+ya na war+dhan+tu/ dge legs su gyur cig shu bham̐ mastu sarba dza ga tam̐/ dge bar gyur cig skye dgu rnams la'o/ /dharme u da ya mastu/ chos 'di rab tu dar bar gyur cig sha sa na sa twa hi twa bha wan+tu/ bstan pa dang sems can la phan thog par gyur cig
